data.input: schema: form(form_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), version(VARCHAR), published(BOOLEAN)) | question: Nombre de formulaires publiés

data.input: schema: relationship(relationship_id(INT), person_a(INT), person_b(INT), relationship(INT)) | question: Total relationships in system

data.input: schema: patient_state(patient_state_id(INT), patient_program_id(INT), state(INT), start_date(DATE)) | question: Count patient states started this year

data.input: schema: drug(drug_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), combination(BOOLEAN), dose_strength(DECIMAL)) | question: Dose moyenne des médicaments

data.input: schema: provider(provider_id(INT), person_id(INT), identifier(VARCHAR), retired(BOOLEAN)) | question: Count of active providers

data.input: schema: conditions(condition_id(INT), patient_id(INT), clinical_status(VARCHAR), voided(BOOLEAN)) | question: Count active conditions

data.input: schema: provider_attribute(provider_attribute_id(INT), provider_id(INT), attribute_type_id(INT), voided(BOOLEAN)) | question: Count active provider attributes

data.input: schema: encounter(encounter_id(INT), encounter_type(INT), location_id(INT)) | question: Count encounters by location

data.sql: SELECT state, COUNT(DISTINCT patient_program_id) as program_count FROM patient_state GROUP BY state

data.input: schema: drug(drug_id(INT), combination(BOOLEAN), creator(INT)) | question: Médicaments créés par utilisateur, par type
data.sql: SELECT creator, combination, COUNT(*) as drug_count FROM drug GROUP BY creator, combination

data.input: schema: provider(provider_id(INT), person_id(INT), provider_role_id(INT)) | question: Provider count by role
data.sql: SELECT provider_role_id, COUNT(*) as provider_count FROM provider GROUP BY provider_role_id

data.input: schema: cohort_member(cohort_member_id(INT), cohort_id(INT), start_date(DATE)) | question: Membres par cohorte et année d'inscription
data.sql: SELECT cohort_id, YEAR(start_date) as year, COUNT(*) as member_count FROM cohort_member WHERE start_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cohort_id, year

data.input: schema: allergy(allergy_id(INT), patient_id(INT), severity(VARCHAR)) | question: Patient allergies by severity
data.sql: SELECT severity, COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) as patient_count FROM allergy GROUP BY severity

data.input: schema: person_attribute(person_attribute_id(INT), attribute_type_id(INT), value(VARCHAR)) | question: Valeurs les plus fréquentes par type d'attribut
data.sql: SELECT attribute_type_id, value, COUNT(*) as frequency FROM person_attribute GROUP BY attribute_type_id, value

data.input: schema: care_setting(care_setting_id(INT), care_setting_type(VARCHAR)), orders(order_id(INT), care_setting(INT)) | question: Orders by care setting type
data.sql: SELECT cs.care_setting_type, COUNT(o.order_id) as order_count FROM care_setting cs JOIN orders o ON cs.care_setting_id = o.care_setting GROUP BY cs.care_setting_type

data.input: schema: encounter_provider(encounter_provider_id(INT), encounter_role_id(INT), provider_id(INT)) | question: Nombre de rencontres par rôle de prestataire
data.sql: SELECT encounter_role_id, COUNT(DISTINCT provider_id) as provider_count FROM encounter_provider GROUP BY encounter_role_id

data.input: schema: conditions(condition_id(INT), clinical_status(VARCHAR), verification_status(VARCHAR)) | question: Conditions by clinical and verification status
data.sql: SELECT clinical_status, verification_status, COUNT(*) as condition_count FROM conditions GROUP BY clinical_status, verification_status

data.input: schema: visit(visit_id(INT), date_started(DATE), visit_type_id(INT)) | question: Visites par type et par jour de la semaine
data.sql: SELECT visit_type_id, DAYOFWEEK(date_started) as day_of_week, COUNT(*) as visit_count FROM visit GROUP BY visit_type_id, day_of_week

data.input: schema: test_order(order_id(INT), specimen_source(INT), urgency(VARCHAR)) | question: Test orders by specimen source and urgency
data.sql: SELECT specimen_source, urgency, COUNT(*) as test_count FROM test_order GROUP BY specimen_source, urgency

data.input: schema: appointment(appointment_id(INT), appointment_type_id(INT), status(VARCHAR)) | question: Rendez-vous par type et statut
data.sql: SELECT appointment_type_id, status, COUNT(*) as appointment_count FROM appointment GROUP BY appointment_type_id, status

data.input: schema: patient_program_attribute(attribute_id(INT), attribute_type_id(INT), patient_program_id(INT)) | question: Attributes per program
data.sql: SELECT patient_program_id, COUNT(DISTINCT attribute_type_id) as attribute_types FROM patient_program_attribute GROUP BY patient_program_id

data.input: schema: encounter(encounter_id(INT), location_id(INT), encounter_datetime(DATETIME)) | question: Consultations par location et heure de la journée
data.sql: SELECT location_id, HOUR(encounter_datetime) as hour, COUNT(*) as encounter_count FROM encounter GROUP BY location_id, hour

data.input: schema: order_frequency(order_frequency_id(INT), concept_id(INT)), drug_order(order_id(INT), frequency(INT)) | question: Drug orders by frequency concept
data.sql: SELECT of.concept_id, COUNT(do.order_id) as order_count FROM order_frequency of JOIN drug_order do ON of.order_frequency_id = do.frequency GROUP BY of.concept_id

data.input: schema: person_name(person_name_id(INT), person_id(INT), preferred(BOOLEAN)) | question: Nombre de noms par personne
data.sql: SELECT person_id, COUNT(*) as name_count FROM person_name GROUP BY person_id

data.input: schema: obs(obs_id(INT), value_coded(INT), concept_id(INT)) | question: Value distribution for each concept
data.sql: SELECT concept_id, value_coded, COUNT(*) as frequency FROM obs WHERE value_coded IS NOT NULL GROUP BY concept_id, value_coded

data.input: schema: location_attribute(attribute_id(INT), location_id(INT), attribute_type_id(INT)) | question: Attributs par location
data.sql: SELECT location_id, COUNT(DISTINCT attribute_type_id) as attribute_types FROM location_attribute GROUP BY location_id

data.input: schema: patient(patient_id(INT), date_created(DATE), creator(INT)) | question: Patients created by user per month
data.sql: SELECT creator, DATE_FORMAT(date_created, '%Y-%m') as month, COUNT(*) as patient_count FROM patient GROUP BY creator, month

data.input: schema: concept_numeric(concept_id(INT), units(VARCHAR)), obs(obs_id(INT), concept_id(INT), value_numeric(DECIMAL)) | question: Moyenne des valeurs par unité de mesure
data.sql: SELECT cn.units, AVG(o.value_numeric) as avg_value FROM concept_numeric cn JOIN obs o ON cn.concept_id = o.concept_id WHERE o.value_numeric IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cn.units

data.input: schema: cohort(cohort_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), cohort_member(cohort_member_id(INT), cohort_id(INT)) | question: Member count by cohort
data.sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(cm.cohort_member_id) as member_count FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN cohort_member cm ON c.cohort_id = cm.cohort_id GROUP BY c.cohort_id, c.name

data.input: schema: diagnosis(diagnosis_id(INT), certainty(VARCHAR), rank(INT)) | question: Diagnostics par niveau de certitude et rang
data.sql: SELECT certainty, rank, COUNT(*) as diagnosis_count FROM diagnosis GROUP BY certainty, rank

data.input: schema: visit(visit_id(INT), patient_id(INT), date_stopped(DATETIME), date_started(DATETIME)) | question: Average visit duration by patient
data.sql: SELECT patient_id, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, date_started, date_stopped)) as avg_duration_hours FROM visit WHERE date_stopped IS NOT NULL GROUP BY patient_id

data.input: schema: encounter_role(encounter_role_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), encounter_provider(encounter_provider_id(INT), encounter_role_id(INT)) | question: Prestataires par rôle
data.sql: SELECT er.name, COUNT(ep.encounter_provider_id) as provider_count FROM encounter_role er LEFT JOIN encounter_provider ep ON er.encounter_role_id = ep.encounter_role_id GROUP BY er.encounter_role_id, er.name

data.input: schema: drug_reference_map(drug_reference_map_id(INT), drug_id(INT), drug_reference_id(INT)) | question: Reference mappings per drug
data.sql: SELECT drug_id, COUNT(DISTINCT drug_reference_id) as reference_count FROM drug_reference_map GROUP BY drug_id

data.input: schema: orders(order_id(INT), orderer(INT), order_type_id(INT)) | question: Commandes par prescripteur et type
data.sql: SELECT orderer, order_type_id, COUNT(*) as order_count FROM orders GROUP BY orderer, order_type_id

data.input: schema: patient_identifier(patient_identifier_id(INT), identifier_type(INT), location_id(INT)) | question: Identifier distribution by location
data.sql: SELECT location_id, identifier_type, COUNT(*) as identifier_count FROM patient_identifier GROUP BY location_id, identifier_type

data.input: schema: concept_class(concept_class_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), concept(concept_id(INT), class_id(INT)) | question: Nombre de concepts par classe
data.sql: SELECT cc.name, COUNT(c.concept_id) as concept_count FROM concept_class cc LEFT JOIN concept c ON cc.concept_class_id = c.class_id GROUP BY cc.concept_class_id, cc.name

data.input: schema: note(note_id(INT), patient_id(INT), priority(INT), date_created(DATE)) | question: Notes by priority and month
data.sql: SELECT priority, DATE_FORMAT(date_created, '%Y-%m') as month, COUNT(*) as note_count FROM note GROUP BY priority, month

data.input: schema: form_field(form_field_id(INT), form_id(INT), field_type(INT)) | question: Champs par type dans chaque formulaire
data.sql: SELECT form_id, field_type, COUNT(*) as field_count FROM form_field GROUP BY form_id, field_type

data.input: schema: program(program_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), patient_program(patient_program_id(INT), program_id(INT)) | question: Patient enrollments per program
data.sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(pp.patient_program_id) as enrollment_count FROM program p LEFT JOIN patient_program pp ON p.program_id = pp.program_id GROUP BY p.program_id, p.name

data.input: schema: person_attribute_type(person_attribute_type_id(INT), format(VARCHAR)), person_attribute(person_attribute_id(INT), attribute_type_id(INT)) | question: Attributs par format de type
data.sql: SELECT pat.format, COUNT(pa.person_attribute_id) as attribute_count FROM person_attribute_type pat LEFT JOIN person_attribute pa ON pat.person_attribute_type_id = pa.attribute_type_id GROUP BY pat.format

data.input: schema: obs(obs_id(INT), location_id(INT), obs_datetime(DATETIME)) | question: Observations by location and year
data.sql: SELECT location_id, YEAR(obs_datetime) as year, COUNT(*) as obs_count FROM obs GROUP BY location_id, year

data.input: schema: encounter_diagnosis(encounter_diagnosis_id(INT), diagnosis_id(INT), encounter_id(INT)) | question: Diagnostics par consultation
data.sql: SELECT encounter_id, COUNT(DISTINCT diagnosis_id) as diagnosis_count FROM encounter_diagnosis GROUP BY encounter_id

data.input: schema: drug_order(order_id(INT), duration_units(INT), duration(INT)) | question: Average prescription duration by unit type
data.sql: SELECT duration_units, AVG(duration) as avg_duration FROM drug_order WHERE duration IS NOT NULL GROUP BY duration_units

data.input: schema: relationship_type(relationship_type_id(INT), a_is_to_b(VARCHAR)), relationship(relationship_id(INT), relationship(INT)) | question: Relations par type de relation
data.sql: SELECT rt.a_is_to_b, COUNT(r.relationship_id) as relationship_count FROM relationship_type rt LEFT JOIN relationship r ON rt.relationship_type_id = r.relationship GROUP BY rt.relationship_type_id, rt.a_is_to_b

data.input: schema: concept_name(concept_name_id(INT), concept_id(INT), locale(VARCHAR)) | question: Concept names by locale
data.sql: SELECT locale, COUNT(DISTINCT concept_id) as concept_count FROM concept_name GROUP BY locale

data.input: schema: patient_program(patient_program_id(INT), outcome_concept_id(INT), date_completed(DATE)) | question: Résultats de programme par mois de complétion
data.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(date_completed, '%Y-%m') as month, outcome_concept_id, COUNT(*) as outcome_count FROM patient_program WHERE date_completed IS NOT NULL AND outcome_concept_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY month, outcome_concept_id

data.input: schema: location_tag(location_tag_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), location_tag_map(location_id(INT), location_tag_id(INT)) | question: Locations per tag
data.sql: SELECT lt.name, COUNT(ltm.location_id) as location_count FROM location_tag lt LEFT JOIN location_tag_map ltm ON lt.location_tag_id = ltm.location_tag_id GROUP BY lt.location_tag_id, lt.name

data.input: schema: order_type(order_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), orders(order_id(INT), order_type_id(INT)) | question: Commandes par type
data.sql: SELECT ot.name, COUNT(o.order_id) as order_count FROM order_type ot LEFT JOIN orders o ON ot.order_type_id = o.order_type_id GROUP BY ot.order_type_id, ot.name

data.input: schema: person(person_id(INT), gender(VARCHAR), dead(BOOLEAN)) | question: Death count by gender
data.sql: SELECT gender, COUNT(*) as death_count FROM person WHERE dead = TRUE GROUP BY gender

data.input: schema: provider_attribute(provider_attribute_id(INT), provider_id(INT), attribute_type_id(INT)) | question: Attributs par prestataire
data.sql: SELECT provider_id, COUNT(DISTINCT attribute_type_id) as attribute_types FROM provider_attribute GROUP BY provider_id

data.input: schema: concept_datatype(concept_datatype_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), concept(concept_id(INT), datatype_id(INT)) | question: Concepts by datatype
data.sql: SELECT cd.name, COUNT(c.concept_id) as concept_count FROM concept_datatype cd LEFT JOIN concept c ON cd.concept_datatype_id = c.datatype_id GROUP BY cd.concept_datatype_id, cd.name

data.input: schema: visit_attribute(attribute_id(INT), visit_id(INT), attribute_type_id(INT)) | question: Attributs par visite
data.sql: SELECT visit_id, COUNT(DISTINCT attribute_type_id) as attribute_types FROM visit_attribute GROUP BY visit_id

data.input: schema: order_set(order_set_id(INT), category(VARCHAR)), order_set_member(order_set_member_id(INT), order_set_id(INT)) | question: Members per order set category
data.sql: SELECT os.category, COUNT(osm.order_set_member_id) as member_count FROM order_set os LEFT JOIN order_set_member osm ON os.order_set_id = osm.order_set_id GROUP BY os.category

data.input: schema: field_type(field_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), field(field_id(INT), field_type(INT)) | question: Champs par type
data.sql: SELECT ft.name, COUNT(f.field_id) as field_count FROM field_type ft LEFT JOIN field f ON ft.field_type_id = f.field_type GROUP BY ft.field_type_id, ft.name

data.input: schema: appointment_type(appointment_type_id(INT), duration(INT)), appointment(appointment_id(INT), appointment_type_id(INT)) | question: Appointments by duration category
data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN at.duration <= 15 THEN 'Court' WHEN at.duration <= 30 THEN 'Moyen' ELSE 'Long' END as duration_category, COUNT(a.appointment_id) as appointment_count FROM appointment_type at JOIN appointment a ON at.appointment_type_id = a.appointment_type_id GROUP BY duration_category

data.input: schema: order_group(order_group_id(INT), patient_id(INT), encounter_id(INT)) | question: Groupes de commandes par patient
data.sql: SELECT patient_id, COUNT(*) as order_group_count FROM order_group GROUP BY patient_id

data.input: schema: concept_proposal(concept_proposal_id(INT), state(VARCHAR), creator(INT)) | question: Proposal submissions by creator and state
data.sql: SELECT creator, state, COUNT(*) as proposal_count FROM concept_proposal GROUP BY creator, state

data.input: schema: concept_answer(concept_answer_id(INT), concept_id(INT), answer_concept(INT)) | question: Nombre de réponses par question
data.sql: SELECT concept_id, COUNT(DISTINCT answer_concept) as answer_count FROM concept_answer GROUP BY concept_id

data.input: schema: patient_identifier_type(patient_identifier_type_id(INT), format(VARCHAR)), patient_identifier(patient_identifier_id(INT), identifier_type(INT)) | question: Identifiers by type format
data.sql: SELECT pit.format, COUNT(pi.patient_identifier_id) as identifier_count FROM patient_identifier_type pit LEFT JOIN patient_identifier pi ON pit.patient_identifier_type_id = pi.identifier_type GROUP BY pit.format

data.input: schema: notification_alert(alert_id(INT), creator(INT), date_created(DATE)) | question: Alertes créées par utilisateur et par mois
data.sql: SELECT creator, DATE_FORMAT(date_created, '%Y-%m') as month, COUNT(*) as alert_count FROM notification_alert GROUP BY creator, month

data.input: schema: concept_set(concept_set_id(INT), concept_set(INT), sort_weight(DECIMAL)) | question: Set members by parent concept
data.sql: SELECT concept_set, COUNT(*) as member_count, AVG(sort_weight) as avg_weight FROM concept_set GROUP BY concept_set

data.input: schema: visit(visit_id(INT), patient_id(INT), location_id(INT)) | question: Visites par patient et location
data.sql: SELECT patient_id, location_id, COUNT(*) as visit_count FROM visit GROUP BY patient_id, location_id

data.input: schema: scheduler_task_config(task_config_id(INT), start_time(DATETIME)), scheduler_task_config_property(task_config_property_id(INT), task_config_id(INT)) | question: Task properties by start hour
data.sql: SELECT HOUR(stc.start_time) as start_hour, COUNT(stcp.task_config_property_id) as property_count FROM scheduler_task_config stc LEFT JOIN scheduler_task_config_property stcp ON stc.task_config_id = stcp.task_config_id GROUP BY start_hour

data.input: schema: encounter_type(encounter_type_id(INT), view_privilege(VARCHAR)), encounter(encounter_id(INT), encounter_type(INT)) | question: Consultations par privilège de visualisation requis
data.sql: SELECT et.view_privilege, COUNT(e.encounter_id) as encounter_count FROM encounter_type et LEFT JOIN encounter e ON et.encounter_type_id = e.encounter_type GROUP BY et.view_privilege

data.input: schema: user_property(user_id(INT), property(VARCHAR), property_value(VARCHAR)) | question: Users by property type
data.sql: SELECT property, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as user_count FROM user_property GROUP BY property

data.input: schema: cohort_member(cohort_member_id(INT), cohort_id(INT), end_date(DATE)) | question: Membres actifs et inactifs par cohorte
data.sql: SELECT cohort_id, SUM(CASE WHEN end_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as active_members, SUM(CASE WHEN end_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as inactive_members FROM cohort_member GROUP BY cohort_id

data.input: schema: form_resource(form_resource_id(INT), form_id(INT), datatype(VARCHAR)) | question: Resources by form and datatype
data.sql: SELECT form_id, datatype, COUNT(*) as resource_count FROM form_resource GROUP BY form_id, datatype

data.input: schema: program_workflow(program_workflow_id(INT), program_id(INT)), program_workflow_state(program_workflow_state_id(INT), program_workflow_id(INT)) | question: États par workflow de programme
data.sql: SELECT pw.program_id, COUNT(pws.program_workflow_state_id) as state_count FROM program_workflow pw LEFT JOIN program_workflow_state pws ON pw.program_workflow_id = pws.program_workflow_id GROUP BY pw.program_id

data.input: schema: conditions(condition_id(INT), patient_id(INT), onset_date(DATE)) | question: New conditions by month
data.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(onset_date, '%Y-%m') as month, COUNT(*) as new_conditions FROM conditions WHERE onset_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY month

data.input: schema: drug_ingredient(drug_ingredient_id(INT), drug_id(INT), ingredient_id(INT)) | question: Nombre d'ingrédients par médicament
data.sql: SELECT drug_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ingredient_id) as ingredient_count FROM drug_ingredient GROUP BY drug_id

data.input: schema: hl7_source(hl7_source_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), hl7_in_archive(hl7_in_archive_id(INT), hl7_source(INT)) | question: Message archive count by HL7 source
data.sql: SELECT hs.name, COUNT(hia.hl7_in_archive_id) as message_count FROM hl7_source hs LEFT JOIN hl7_in_archive hia ON hs.hl7_source_id = hia.hl7_source GROUP BY hs.hl7_source_id, hs.name

data.input: schema: obs(obs_id(INT), person_id(INT), voided(BOOLEAN), voided_by(INT)) | question: Observations annulées par utilisateur
data.sql: SELECT voided_by, COUNT(*) as voided_count FROM obs WHERE voided = TRUE AND voided_by IS NOT NULL GROUP BY voided_by

data.input: schema: patient_program(patient_program_id(INT), program_id(INT), location_id(INT)) | question: Program enrollments by location
data.sql: SELECT location_id, program_id, COUNT(*) as enrollment_count FROM patient_program GROUP BY location_id, program_id

data.input: schema: concept_reference_source(concept_source_id(INT), hl7_code(VARCHAR)), concept_reference_term(concept_reference_term_id(INT), concept_source_id(INT)) | question: Termes de référence par code HL7 de la source
data.sql: SELECT crs.hl7_code, COUNT(crt.concept_reference_term_id) as term_count FROM concept_reference_source crs LEFT JOIN concept_reference_term crt ON crs.concept_source_id = crt.concept_source_id GROUP BY crs.hl7_code

data.input: schema: field(field_id(INT), concept_id(INT)), field_answer(field_id(INT), answer_id(INT)) | question: Answer options per field concept
data.sql: SELECT f.concept_id, COUNT(fa.answer_id) as answer_count FROM field f LEFT JOIN field_answer fa ON f.field_id = fa.field_id GROUP BY f.concept_id

data.input: schema: allergy(allergy_id(INT), allergen_type(VARCHAR)), allergy_reaction(allergy_reaction_id(INT), allergy_id(INT)) | question: Réactions par type d'allergène
data.sql: SELECT a.allergen_type, COUNT(ar.allergy_reaction_id) as reaction_count FROM allergy a LEFT JOIN allergy_reaction ar ON a.allergy_id = ar.allergy_id GROUP BY a.allergen_type

data.input: schema: orders(order_id(INT), care_setting(INT), date_activated(DATE)) | question: Orders by care setting and month
data.sql: SELECT care_setting, DATE_FORMAT(date_activated, '%Y-%m') as month, COUNT(*) as order_count FROM orders WHERE date_activated IS NOT NULL GROUP BY care_setting, month

data.input: schema: concept_map_type(concept_map_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), concept_reference_map(concept_map_id(INT), concept_map_type_id(INT)) | question: Mappings par type
data.sql: SELECT cmt.name, COUNT(crm.concept_map_id) as mapping_count FROM concept_map_type cmt LEFT JOIN concept_reference_map crm ON cmt.concept_map_type_id = crm.concept_map_type_id GROUP BY cmt.concept_map_type_id, cmt.name

data.input: schema: program_workflow_state(program_workflow_state_id(INT), program_workflow_id(INT), initial(BOOLEAN), terminal(BOOLEAN)) | question: State types by workflow
data.sql: SELECT program_workflow_id, SUM(CASE WHEN initial = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as initial_states, SUM(CASE WHEN terminal = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as terminal_states FROM program_workflow_state GROUP BY program_workflow_id

data.input: schema: patient(patient_id(INT), gender(VARCHAR)), encounter(encounter_id(INT), patient_id(INT)) | question: Genres de patients ayant plus de 10 consultations
data.sql: SELECT p.gender, COUNT(e.encounter_id) as encounter_count FROM patient p JOIN encounter e ON p.patient_id = e.patient_id GROUP BY p.gender HAVING COUNT(e.encounter_id) > 10

data.input: schema: provider(provider_id(INT), person_id(INT)), encounter_provider(encounter_provider_id(INT), provider_id(INT), encounter_id(INT)) | question: Providers with more than 50 encounters
data.sql: SELECT p.provider_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ep.encounter_id) as encounter_count FROM provider p JOIN encounter_provider ep ON p.provider_id = ep.provider_id GROUP BY p.provider_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ep.encounter_id) > 50

data.input: schema: location(location_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), visit(visit_id(INT), location_id(INT), date_started(DATETIME)) | question: Locations avec plus de 100 visites ce mois
data.sql: SELECT l.name, COUNT(v.visit_id) as visit_count FROM location l JOIN visit v ON l.location_id = v.location_id WHERE MONTH(v.date_started) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(v.date_started) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY l.location_id, l.name HAVING COUNT(v.visit_id) > 100

data.input: schema: concept(concept_id(INT), datatype_id(INT)), obs(obs_id(INT), concept_id(INT), value_numeric(DECIMAL)) | question: Concepts with average numeric value above 100
data.sql: SELECT c.concept_id, AVG(o.value_numeric) as avg_value FROM concept c JOIN obs o ON c.concept_id = o.concept_id WHERE o.value_numeric IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.concept_id HAVING AVG(o.value_numeric) > 100

data.input: schema: patient_program(patient_program_id(INT), program_id(INT), patient_id(INT), date_enrolled(DATE)) | question: Programmes avec moins de 5 inscriptions cette année
data.sql: SELECT program_id, COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) as patient_count FROM patient_program WHERE YEAR(date_enrolled) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY program_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) < 5

data.input: schema: drug_order(order_id(INT), drug_inventory_id(INT), dose(DECIMAL), quantity(INT)) | question: Drugs with total quantity ordered exceeding 1000 units
data.sql: SELECT drug_inventory_id, SUM(quantity) as total_quantity FROM drug_order GROUP BY drug_inventory_id HAVING SUM(quantity) > 1000

data.input: schema: patient(patient_id(INT), date_created(DATETIME)), obs(obs_id(INT), person_id(INT), concept_id(INT)) | question: Patients créés ce mois avec plus de 20 observations
data.sql: SELECT p.patient_id, COUNT(o.obs_id) as obs_count FROM patient p JOIN obs o ON p.patient_id = o.person_id WHERE MONTH(p.date_created) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(p.date_created) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY p.patient_id HAVING COUNT(o.obs_id) > 20

data.input: schema: person(person_id(INT), birthdate(DATE)), allergy(allergy_id(INT), patient_id(INT)) | question: Age groups with more than 10 patients having allergies
data.sql: SELECT FLOOR(TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.birthdate, CURDATE())/10)*10 as age_group, COUNT(DISTINCT a.patient_id) as patient_count FROM person p JOIN allergy a ON p.person_id = a.patient_id WHERE p.birthdate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY age_group HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.patient_id) > 10

data.input: schema: users(user_id(INT), username(VARCHAR)), encounter(encounter_id(INT), creator(INT)) | question: Utilisateurs ayant créé plus de 100 consultations
data.sql: SELECT u.username, COUNT(e.encounter_id) as encounters_created FROM users u JOIN encounter e ON u.user_id = e.creator GROUP BY u.user_id, u.username HAVING COUNT(e.encounter_id) > 100

data.input: schema: form(form_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), encounter(encounter_id(INT), form_id(INT)) | question: Forms used in less than 10 encounters
data.sql: SELECT f.name, COUNT(e.encounter_id) as usage_count FROM form f LEFT JOIN encounter e ON f.form_id = e.form_id GROUP BY f.form_id, f.name HAVING COUNT(e.encounter_id) < 10

data.input: schema: concept_class(concept_class_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), concept(concept_id(INT), class_id(INT)) | question: Classes de concepts avec plus de 50 concepts
data.sql: SELECT cc.name, COUNT(c.concept_id) as concept_count FROM concept_class cc JOIN concept c ON cc.concept_class_id = c.class_id GROUP BY cc.concept_class_id, cc.name HAVING COUNT(c.concept_id) > 50

data.input: schema: visit_type(visit_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), visit(visit_id(INT), visit_type_id(INT), date_started(DATETIME), date_stopped(DATETIME)) | question: Visit types with average duration over 2 hours
data.sql: SELECT vt.name, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, v.date_started, v.date_stopped)) as avg_duration FROM visit_type vt JOIN visit v ON vt.visit_type_id = v.visit_type_id WHERE v.date_stopped IS NOT NULL GROUP BY vt.visit_type_id, vt.name HAVING AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, v.date_started, v.date_stopped)) > 2

data.input: schema: person_address(person_address_id(INT), city_village(VARCHAR), state_province(VARCHAR), person_id(INT)) | question: Villes avec plus de 100 personnes dans la même province
data.sql: SELECT city_village, state_province, COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) as person_count FROM person_address WHERE city_village IS NOT NULL AND state_province IS NOT NULL GROUP BY city_village, state_province HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) > 100

data.input: schema: orders(order_id(INT), orderer(INT), order_type_id(INT), date_activated(DATE)) | question: Orderers with more than 50 orders this month
data.sql: SELECT orderer, COUNT(*) as order_count FROM orders WHERE MONTH(date_activated) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(date_activated) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY orderer HAVING COUNT(*) > 50

data.input: schema: cohort(cohort_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), cohort_member(cohort_member_id(INT), cohort_id(INT), patient_id(INT)) | question: Cohortes avec moins de 20 membres actifs
data.sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(cm.patient_id) as member_count FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN cohort_member cm ON c.cohort_id = cm.cohort_id WHERE cm.end_date IS NULL OR cm.end_date > CURDATE() GROUP BY c.cohort_id, c.name HAVING COUNT(cm.patient_id) < 20

data.input: schema: patient_identifier_type(patient_identifier_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), patient_identifier(patient_identifier_id(INT), identifier_type(INT)) | question: Identifier types used by more than 1000 patients
data.sql: SELECT pit.name, COUNT(DISTINCT pi.patient_id) as patient_count FROM patient_identifier_type pit JOIN patient_identifier pi ON pit.patient_identifier_type_id = pi.identifier_type GROUP BY pit.patient_identifier_type_id, pit.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pi.patient_id) > 1000

data.input: schema: appointment_type(appointment_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), duration(INT)), appointment(appointment_id(INT), appointment_type_id(INT), status(VARCHAR)) | question: Types de RDV avec plus de 80% de confirmations
data.sql: SELECT at.name, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status = 'CONFIRMED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as confirmation_rate FROM appointment_type at JOIN appointment a ON at.appointment_type_id = a.appointment_type_id GROUP BY at.appointment_type_id, at.name HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status = 'CONFIRMED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > 80

data.input: schema: drug(drug_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), drug_order(order_id(INT), drug_inventory_id(INT), discontinued(BOOLEAN)) | question: Drugs with discontinuation rate above 30%
data.sql: SELECT d.name, COUNT(CASE WHEN do.discontinued = TRUE THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as discontinuation_rate FROM drug d JOIN drug_order do ON d.drug_id = do.drug_inventory_id GROUP BY d.drug_id, d.name HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN do.discontinued = TRUE THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > 30

data.input: schema: encounter_type(encounter_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), encounter(encounter_id(INT), encounter_type(INT), patient_id(INT)) | question: Types de consultation avec plus de 500 patients uniques
data.sql: SELECT et.name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.patient_id) as unique_patients FROM encounter_type et JOIN encounter e ON et.encounter_type_id = e.encounter_type GROUP BY et.encounter_type_id, et.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.patient_id) > 500

data.input: schema: provider_role(provider_role_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), provider(provider_id(INT), provider_role_id(INT)), encounter_provider(encounter_provider_id(INT), provider_id(INT)) | question: Provider roles with average encounters per provider exceeding 20
data.sql: SELECT pr.name, COUNT(ep.encounter_provider_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT p.provider_id) as avg_encounters_per_provider FROM provider_role pr JOIN provider p ON pr.provider_role_id = p.provider_role_id LEFT JOIN encounter_provider ep ON p.provider_id = ep.provider_id GROUP BY pr.provider_role_id, pr.name HAVING COUNT(ep.encounter_provider_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT p.provider_id) > 20

data.input: schema: program(program_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), patient_program(patient_program_id(INT), program_id(INT), date_completed(DATE)) | question: Programmes avec taux de complétion supérieur à 70%
data.sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(CASE WHEN pp.date_completed IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as completion_rate FROM program p JOIN patient_program pp ON p.program_id = pp.program_id GROUP BY p.program_id, p.name HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN pp.date_completed IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > 70

data.input: schema: person(person_id(INT), gender(VARCHAR)), obs(obs_id(INT), person_id(INT), concept_id(INT)) | question: Genders with more than 1000 observations for concept 5089
data.sql: SELECT p.gender, COUNT(o.obs_id) as obs_count FROM person p JOIN obs o ON p.person_id = o.person_id WHERE o.concept_id = 5089 GROUP BY p.gender HAVING COUNT(o.obs_id) > 1000

data.input: schema: relationship_type(relationship_type_id(INT), a_is_to_b(VARCHAR)), relationship(relationship_id(INT), relationship(INT), person_a(INT)) | question: Types de relation avec plus de 50 relations actives
data.sql: SELECT rt.a_is_to_b, COUNT(r.relationship_id) as relationship_count FROM relationship_type rt JOIN relationship r ON rt.relationship_type_id = r.relationship GROUP BY rt.relationship_type_id, rt.a_is_to_b HAVING COUNT(r.relationship_id) > 50

data.input: schema: concept_datatype(concept_datatype_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), concept(concept_id(INT), datatype_id(INT)), concept_name(concept_name_id(INT), concept_id(INT)) | question: Datatypes with concepts having more than 3 names on average
data.sql: SELECT cd.name, COUNT(cn.concept_name_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.concept_id) as avg_names_per_concept FROM concept_datatype cd JOIN concept c ON cd.concept_datatype_id = c.datatype_id LEFT JOIN concept_name cn ON c.concept_id = cn.concept_id GROUP BY cd.concept_datatype_id, cd.name HAVING COUNT(cn.concept_name_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.concept_id) > 3

data.input: schema: patient_state(patient_state_id(INT), state(INT), patient_program_id(INT), start_date(DATE), end_date(DATE)) | question: États avec durée moyenne supérieure à 180 jours
data.sql: SELECT state, AVG(DATEDIFF(end_date, start_date)) as avg_duration_days FROM patient_state WHERE end_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY state HAVING AVG(DATEDIFF(end_date, start_date)) > 180

data.input: schema: care_setting(care_setting_id(INT), care_setting_type(VARCHAR)), orders(order_id(INT), care_setting(INT), voided(BOOLEAN)) | question: Care settings with void rate below 5%
data.sql: SELECT cs.care_setting_type, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.voided = TRUE THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as void_rate FROM care_setting cs JOIN orders o ON cs.care_setting_id = o.care_setting GROUP BY cs.care_setting_type HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN o.voided = TRUE THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) < 5

data.input: schema: conditions(condition_id(INT), clinical_status(VARCHAR), patient_id(INT)) | question: Statuts cliniques affectant plus de 100 patients
data.sql: SELECT clinical_status, COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) as patient_count FROM conditions GROUP BY clinical_status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) > 100

data.input: schema: visit(visit_id(INT), patient_id(INT), location_id(INT)), patient(patient_id(INT), birthdate(DATE)) | question: Locations with average patient age below 18
data.sql: SELECT v.location_id, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.birthdate, CURDATE())) as avg_age FROM visit v JOIN patient p ON v.patient_id = p.patient_id WHERE p.birthdate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY v.location_id HAVING AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.birthdate, CURDATE())) < 18

data.input: schema: test_order(order_id(INT), specimen_source(INT), urgency(VARCHAR)) | question: Sources d'échantillon avec plus de 80% de tests urgents
data.sql: SELECT specimen_source, COUNT(CASE WHEN urgency = 'URGENT' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as urgent_percentage FROM test_order GROUP BY specimen_source HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN urgency = 'URGENT' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > 80

data.input: schema: allergy(allergy_id(INT), patient_id(INT), severity(VARCHAR), allergen(VARCHAR)) | question: Allergens causing severe reactions in more than 20 patients
data.sql: SELECT allergen, COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) as severe_reaction_count FROM allergy WHERE severity = 'SEVERE' GROUP BY allergen HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) > 20

data.input: schema: person_attribute_type(person_attribute_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), person_attribute(person_attribute_id(INT), attribute_type_id(INT), person_id(INT)) | question: Types d'attributs utilisés par moins de 10 personnes
data.sql: SELECT pat.name, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.person_id) as person_count FROM person_attribute_type pat LEFT JOIN person_attribute pa ON pat.person_attribute_type_id = pa.attribute_type_id GROUP BY pat.person_attribute_type_id, pat.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pa.person_id) < 10

data.input: schema: encounter_role(encounter_role_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), encounter_provider(encounter_provider_id(INT), encounter_role_id(INT), encounter_id(INT)) | question: Encounter roles used in more than 1000 encounters
data.sql: SELECT er.name, COUNT(DISTINCT ep.encounter_id) as encounter_count FROM encounter_role er JOIN encounter_provider ep ON er.encounter_role_id = ep.encounter_role_id GROUP BY er.encounter_role_id, er.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ep.encounter_id) > 1000

data.input: schema: drug_reference_map(drug_reference_map_id(INT), drug_id(INT)), drug(drug_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), combination(BOOLEAN)) | question: Médicaments combinés avec plus de 5 références
data.sql: SELECT d.name, COUNT(drm.drug_reference_map_id) as reference_count FROM drug d JOIN drug_reference_map drm ON d.drug_id = drm.drug_id WHERE d.combination = TRUE GROUP BY d.drug_id, d.name HAVING COUNT(drm.drug_reference_map_id) > 5

data.input: schema: orders(order_id(INT), order_type_id(INT), discontinued(BOOLEAN), discontinued_reason(INT)) | question: Order types with discontinuation rate above 25%
data.sql: SELECT order_type_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN discontinued = TRUE THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as discontinuation_rate FROM orders GROUP BY order_type_id HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN discontinued = TRUE THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > 25

data.input: schema: patient_identifier(patient_identifier_id(INT), identifier_type(INT), location_id(INT), voided(BOOLEAN)) | question: Locations avec plus de 10% d'identifiants annulés
data.sql: SELECT location_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN voided = TRUE THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as void_rate FROM patient_identifier WHERE location_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY location_id HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN voided = TRUE THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > 10

data.input: schema: concept_class(concept_class_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), concept(concept_id(INT), class_id(INT)), obs(obs_id(INT), concept_id(INT)) | question: Concept classes with more than 10000 observations
data.sql: SELECT cc.name, COUNT(o.obs_id) as obs_count FROM concept_class cc JOIN concept c ON cc.concept_class_id = c.class_id JOIN obs o ON c.concept_id = o.concept_id GROUP BY cc.concept_class_id, cc.name HAVING COUNT(o.obs_id) > 10000

data.input: schema: note(note_id(INT), patient_id(INT), priority(INT), text(TEXT)) | question: Patients avec plus de 5 notes de priorité élevée (>7)
data.sql: SELECT patient_id, COUNT(*) as high_priority_notes FROM note WHERE priority > 7 GROUP BY patient_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 5

data.input: schema: form_field(form_field_id(INT), form_id(INT), required(BOOLEAN)), form(form_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)) | question: Forms with more than 10 required fields
data.sql: SELECT f.name, COUNT(ff.form_field_id) as required_fields FROM form f JOIN form_field ff ON f.form_id = ff.form_id WHERE ff.required = TRUE GROUP BY f.form_id, f.name HAVING COUNT(ff.form_field_id) > 10

data.input: schema: program(program_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), patient_program(patient_program_id(INT), program_id(INT)), patient_state(patient_state_id(INT), patient_program_id(INT)) | question: Programmes avec moyenne de plus de 5 états par patient
data.sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(ps.patient_state_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT pp.patient_program_id) as avg_states_per_enrollment FROM program p JOIN patient_program pp ON p.program_id = pp.program_id LEFT JOIN patient_state ps ON pp.patient_program_id = ps.patient_program_id GROUP BY p.program_id, p.name HAVING COUNT(ps.patient_state_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT pp.patient_program_id) > 5

data.input: schema: location_tag(location_tag_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), location_tag_map(location_id(INT), location_tag_id(INT)), location(location_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)) | question: Location tags applied to more than 20 locations
data.sql: SELECT lt.name, COUNT(DISTINCT ltm.location_id) as location_count FROM location_tag lt JOIN location_tag_map ltm ON lt.location_tag_id = ltm.location_tag_id GROUP BY lt.location_tag_id, lt.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ltm.location_id) > 20

data.input: schema: obs(obs_id(INT), concept_id(INT), obs_datetime(DATETIME), location_id(INT)) | question: Locations avec plus de 1000 observations par mois en moyenne
data.sql: SELECT location_id, COUNT(*) / COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(obs_datetime, '%Y-%m')) as avg_monthly_obs FROM obs WHERE obs_datetime IS NOT NULL GROUP BY location_id HAVING COUNT(*) / COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(obs_datetime, '%Y-%m')) > 1000

data.input: schema: encounter_diagnosis(encounter_diagnosis_id(INT), diagnosis_id(INT), rank(INT)), diagnosis(diagnosis_id(INT), diagnosis_coded(INT)) | question: Diagnosis codes appearing as primary diagnosis more than 50 times
data.sql: SELECT d.diagnosis_coded, COUNT(ed.encounter_diagnosis_id) as primary_count FROM diagnosis d JOIN encounter_diagnosis ed ON d.diagnosis_id = ed.diagnosis_id WHERE ed.rank = 1 GROUP BY d.diagnosis_coded HAVING COUNT(ed.encounter_diagnosis_id) > 50

data.input: schema: drug_order(order_id(INT), duration(INT), duration_units(INT), dose(DECIMAL)) | question: Unités de durée avec dose moyenne supérieure à 500mg
data.sql: SELECT duration_units, AVG(dose) as avg_dose FROM drug_order WHERE dose IS NOT NULL GROUP BY duration_units HAVING AVG(dose) > 500

data.input: schema: concept_name(concept_name_id(INT), concept_id(INT), locale(VARCHAR), voided(BOOLEAN)) | question: Locales with more than 1000 concept names
data.sql: SELECT locale, COUNT(*) as name_count FROM concept_name WHERE voided = FALSE GROUP BY locale HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000

data.input: schema: patient_program(patient_program_id(INT), program_id(INT), outcome_concept_id(INT)), concept_name(concept_name_id(INT), concept_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)) | question: Programmes avec plus de 3 types de résultats différents
data.sql: SELECT pp.program_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pp.outcome_concept_id) as outcome_types FROM patient_program pp WHERE pp.outcome_concept_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY pp.program_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pp.outcome_concept_id) > 3

data.input: schema: order_type(order_type_id(INT), java_class_name(VARCHAR)), orders(order_id(INT), order_type_id(INT)) | question: Order type classes with more than 5000 orders
data.sql: SELECT ot.java_class_name, COUNT(o.order_id) as order_count FROM order_type ot JOIN orders o ON ot.order_type_id = o.order_type_id GROUP BY ot.java_class_name HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 5000

data.input: schema: person(person_id(INT), dead(BOOLEAN), death_date(DATE), cause_of_death(INT)) | question: Causes de décès affectant plus de 10 personnes
data.sql: SELECT cause_of_death, COUNT(*) as death_count FROM person WHERE dead = TRUE AND cause_of_death IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cause_of_death HAVING COUNT(*) > 10

data.input: schema: provider_attribute_type(provider_attribute_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), provider_attribute(provider_attribute_id(INT), attribute_type_id(INT), provider_id(INT)) | question: Provider attribute types used by more than 50 providers
data.sql: SELECT pat.name, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.provider_id) as provider_count FROM provider_attribute_type pat JOIN provider_attribute pa ON pat.provider_attribute_type_id = pa.attribute_type_id GROUP BY pat.provider_attribute_type_id, pat.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pa.provider_id) > 50

data.input: schema: visit_attribute_type(visit_attribute_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), visit_attribute(attribute_id(INT), visit_id(INT), attribute_type_id(INT)) | question: Types d'attributs de visite utilisés dans plus de 100 visites
data.sql: SELECT vat.name, COUNT(DISTINCT va.visit_id) as visit_count FROM visit_attribute_type vat JOIN visit_attribute va ON vat.visit_attribute_type_id = va.attribute_type_id GROUP BY vat.visit_attribute_type_id, vat.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT va.visit_id) > 100

data.input: schema: order_set(order_set_id(INT), category(VARCHAR)), order_set_member(order_set_member_id(INT), order_set_id(INT)) | question: Order set categories with average members exceeding 10
data.sql: SELECT os.category, COUNT(osm.order_set_member_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT os.order_set_id) as avg_members FROM order_set os LEFT JOIN order_set_member osm ON os.order_set_id = osm.order_set_id WHERE os.category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY os.category HAVING COUNT(osm.order_set_member_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT os.order_set_id) > 10

data.input: schema: field_type(field_type_id(INT), is_set(BOOLEAN)), field(field_id(INT), field_type(INT)), form_field(form_field_id(INT), field_id(INT)) | question: Types de champs ensemble utilisés dans plus de 20 formulaires
data.sql: SELECT ft.field_type_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ff.form_id) as form_count FROM field_type ft JOIN field f ON ft.field_type_id = f.field_type JOIN form_field ff ON f.field_id = ff.field_id WHERE ft.is_set = TRUE GROUP BY ft.field_type_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ff.form_id) > 20

data.input: schema: appointment(appointment_id(INT), appointment_type_id(INT), patient_id(INT), status(VARCHAR)) | question: Appointment types with more than 20% no-show rate
data.sql: SELECT appointment_type_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'MISSED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as no_show_rate FROM appointment GROUP BY appointment_type_id HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'MISSED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > 20

data.input: schema: order_group(order_group_id(INT), patient_id(INT)), orders(order_id(INT), order_group_id(INT)) | question: Patients avec groupes de commandes contenant plus de 10 ordres
data.sql: SELECT og.patient_id, COUNT(o.order_id) as orders_in_group FROM order_group og JOIN orders o ON og.order_group_id = o.order_group_id GROUP BY og.patient_id, og.order_group_id HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 10

data.input: schema: concept_proposal(concept_proposal_id(INT), state(VARCHAR), creator(INT), date_created(DATE)) | question: Creators with more than 5 pending proposals
data.sql: SELECT creator, COUNT(*) as pending_proposals FROM concept_proposal WHERE state = 'PENDING' GROUP BY creator HAVING COUNT(*) > 5

data.input: schema: concept_answer(concept_answer_id(INT), concept_id(INT), answer_concept(INT)), concept(concept_id(INT), is_set(BOOLEAN)) | question: Concepts ensembles avec plus de 10 réponses possibles
data.sql: SELECT ca.concept_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.answer_concept) as answer_count FROM concept_answer ca JOIN concept c ON ca.concept_id = c.concept_id WHERE c.is_set = TRUE GROUP BY ca.concept_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca.answer_concept) > 10

data.input: schema: patient_identifier_type(patient_identifier_type_id(INT), required(BOOLEAN), check_digit(BOOLEAN)), patient_identifier(patient_identifier_id(INT), identifier_type(INT)) | question: Required identifier types with check digit having less than 95% valid identifiers
data.sql: SELECT pit.patient_identifier_type_id, COUNT(pi.patient_identifier_id) as total_identifiers FROM patient_identifier_type pit LEFT JOIN patient_identifier pi ON pit.patient_identifier_type_id = pi.identifier_type WHERE pit.required = TRUE AND pit.check_digit = TRUE GROUP BY pit.patient_identifier_type_id HAVING COUNT(pi.patient_identifier_id) < 95

data.input: schema: notification_alert(alert_id(INT), creator(INT), satisfied_by_any(BOOLEAN)) | question: Créateurs avec plus de 10 alertes non satisfaites
data.sql: SELECT creator, COUNT(*) as unsatisfied_alerts FROM notification_alert WHERE satisfied_by_any = FALSE GROUP BY creator HAVING COUNT(*) > 10

data.input: schema: concept_set(concept_set_id(INT), concept_set(INT), sort_weight(DECIMAL)) | question: Parent concept sets with average sort weight above 5
data.sql: SELECT concept_set, AVG(sort_weight) as avg_weight FROM concept_set WHERE sort_weight IS NOT NULL GROUP BY concept_set HAVING AVG(sort_weight) > 5

data.input: schema: visit(visit_id(INT), patient_id(INT), date_started(DATETIME)), encounter(encounter_id(INT), visit_id(INT)) | question: Patients avec visites ayant plus de 10 consultations en moyenne
data.sql: SELECT v.patient_id, COUNT(e.encounter_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT v.visit_id) as avg_encounters_per_visit FROM visit v LEFT JOIN encounter e ON v.visit_id = e.visit_id GROUP BY v.patient_id HAVING COUNT(e.encounter_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT v.visit_id) > 10

data.input: schema: scheduler_task_config(task_config_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), start_on_startup(BOOLEAN)), scheduler_task_config_property(task_config_property_id(INT), task_config_id(INT)) | question: Startup tasks with more than 5 configuration properties
data.sql: SELECT stc.name, COUNT(stcp.task_config_property_id) as property_count FROM scheduler_task_config stc JOIN scheduler_task_config_property stcp ON stc.task_config_id = stcp.task_config_id WHERE stc.start_on_startup = TRUE GROUP BY stc.task_config_id, stc.name HAVING COUNT(stcp.task_config_property_id) > 5

data.input: schema: user_property(user_id(INT), property(VARCHAR), property_value(VARCHAR)), users(user_id(INT), retired(BOOLEAN)) | question: Propriétés utilisateur définies pour plus de 100 utilisateurs actifs
data.sql: SELECT up.property, COUNT(DISTINCT up.user_id) as user_count FROM user_property up JOIN users u ON up.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.retired = FALSE GROUP BY up.property HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT up.user_id) > 100

data.input: schema: cohort_member(cohort_member_id(INT), cohort_id(INT), patient_id(INT), start_date(DATE), end_date(DATE)) | question: Cohorts with member retention rate above 80%
data.sql: SELECT cohort_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN end_date IS NULL OR end_date > CURDATE() THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as retention_rate FROM cohort_member GROUP BY cohort_id HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN end_date IS NULL OR end_date > CURDATE() THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > 80

data.input: schema: form_resource(form_resource_id(INT), form_id(INT), datatype(VARCHAR), value_reference(TEXT)) | question: Formulaires avec plus de 3 types de ressources différents
data.sql: SELECT form_id, COUNT(DISTINCT datatype) as datatype_count FROM form_resource GROUP BY form_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT datatype) > 3

data.input: schema: program_workflow(program_workflow_id(INT), program_id(INT)), program_workflow_state(program_workflow_state_id(INT), program_workflow_id(INT), terminal(BOOLEAN)) | question: Programs with workflows having more than 2 terminal states
data.sql: SELECT pw.program_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN pws.terminal = TRUE THEN 1 END) as terminal_state_count FROM program_workflow pw JOIN program_workflow_state pws ON pw.program_workflow_id = pws.program_workflow_id GROUP BY pw.program_id HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN pws.terminal = TRUE THEN 1 END) > 2

data.input: schema: conditions(condition_id(INT), patient_id(INT), clinical_status(VARCHAR), onset_date(DATE)) | question: Patients avec plus de 5 conditions actives simultanément
data.sql: SELECT patient_id, COUNT(*) as active_conditions FROM conditions WHERE clinical_status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY patient_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 5

data.input: schema: drug_ingredient(drug_ingredient_id(INT), drug_id(INT), ingredient_id(INT), strength(DECIMAL)) | question: Drugs with more than 3 active ingredients
data.sql: SELECT drug_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ingredient_id) as ingredient_count FROM drug_ingredient GROUP BY drug_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ingredient_id) > 3

data.input: schema: hl7_in_archive(hl7_in_archive_id(INT), hl7_source(INT), date_created(DATETIME)) | question: Sources HL7 avec plus de 1000 messages archivés ce mois
data.sql: SELECT hl7_source, COUNT(*) as message_count FROM hl7_in_archive WHERE MONTH(date_created) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(date_created) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY hl7_source HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000

data.input: schema: obs(obs_id(INT), person_id(INT), concept_id(INT), voided(BOOLEAN), voided_by(INT)) | question: Users who voided more than 50 observations
data.sql: SELECT voided_by, COUNT(*) as voided_count FROM obs WHERE voided = TRUE AND voided_by IS NOT NULL GROUP BY voided_by HAVING COUNT(*) > 50

data.input: schema: patient_program(patient_program_id(INT), program_id(INT), location_id(INT), date_enrolled(DATE)) | question: Programmes par location avec plus de 50% d'inscriptions ce trimestre
data.sql: SELECT program_id, location_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN date_enrolled >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH) THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as recent_enrollment_rate FROM patient_program WHERE location_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY program_id, location_id HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN date_enrolled >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH) THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > 50

data.input: schema: concept_reference_term(concept_reference_term_id(INT), concept_source_id(INT), code(VARCHAR)) | question: Concept sources with more than 500 unique codes
data.sql: SELECT concept_source_id, COUNT(DISTINCT code) as unique_codes FROM concept_reference_term GROUP BY concept_source_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT code) > 500

data.input: schema: field(field_id(INT), concept_id(INT), table_name(VARCHAR)), field_answer(field_id(INT), answer_id(INT)) | question: Tables avec champs ayant plus de 15 options de réponse en moyenne
data.sql: SELECT f.table_name, COUNT(fa.answer_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT f.field_id) as avg_answers_per_field FROM field f LEFT JOIN field_answer fa ON f.field_id = fa.field_id WHERE f.table_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY f.table_name HAVING COUNT(fa.answer_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT f.field_id) > 15

data.input: schema: allergy(allergy_id(INT), patient_id(INT), allergen_type(VARCHAR)), allergy_reaction(allergy_reaction_id(INT), allergy_id(INT), reaction_concept_id(INT)) | question: Allergen types causing more than 3 different reactions on average
data.sql: SELECT a.allergen_type, COUNT(DISTINCT ar.reaction_concept_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT a.allergy_id) as avg_reactions FROM allergy a LEFT JOIN allergy_reaction ar ON a.allergy_id = ar.allergy_id GROUP BY a.allergen_type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ar.reaction_concept_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT a.allergy_id) > 3

data.input: schema: orders(order_id(INT), care_setting(INT), auto_expire_date(DATETIME)) | question: Paramètres de soins avec plus de 30% de commandes auto-expirées
data.sql: SELECT care_setting, COUNT(CASE WHEN auto_expire_date < CURDATE() THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as expired_rate FROM orders WHERE auto_expire_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY care_setting HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN auto_expire_date < CURDATE() THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > 30

data.input: schema: concept_map_type(concept_map_type_id(INT), is_hidden(BOOLEAN)), concept_reference_map(concept_map_id(INT), concept_map_type_id(INT)) | question: Hidden map types with more than 100 mappings
data.sql: SELECT cmt.concept_map_type_id, COUNT(crm.concept_map_id) as mapping_count FROM concept_map_type cmt JOIN concept_reference_map crm ON cmt.concept_map_type_id = crm.concept_map_type_id WHERE cmt.is_hidden = TRUE GROUP BY cmt.concept_map_type_id HAVING COUNT(crm.concept_map_id) > 100

data.input: schema: program_workflow_state(program_workflow_state_id(INT), program_workflow_id(INT), initial(BOOLEAN)), patient_state(patient_state_id(INT), state(INT), patient_program_id(INT)) | question: États initiaux utilisés par plus de 200 patients
data.sql: SELECT pws.program_workflow_state_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.patient_program_id) as patient_count FROM program_workflow_state pws JOIN patient_state ps ON pws.program_workflow_state_id = ps.state WHERE pws.initial = TRUE GROUP BY pws.program_workflow_state_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ps.patient_program_id) > 200

data.input: schema: encounter(encounter_id(INT), patient_id(INT), encounter_type(INT), voided(BOOLEAN)) | question: Patients with void rate exceeding 10% for their encounters
data.sql: SELECT patient_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN voided = TRUE THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as void_rate FROM encounter GROUP BY patient_id HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN voided = TRUE THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > 10

data.input: schema: person(person_id(INT), birthdate(DATE)), patient_program(patient_program_id(INT), patient_id(INT), program_id(INT)) | question: Programmes avec âge moyen des patients inférieur à 5 ans
data.sql: SELECT pp.program_id, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.birthdate, CURDATE())) as avg_age FROM patient_program pp JOIN person p ON pp.patient_id = p.person_id WHERE p.birthdate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY pp.program_id HAVING AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.birthdate, CURDATE())) < 5

data.input: schema: diagnosis(diagnosis_id(INT), diagnosis_coded(INT), certainty(VARCHAR)), encounter_diagnosis(encounter_diagnosis_id(INT), diagnosis_id(INT), encounter_id(INT)) | question: Coded diagnoses with presumed certainty in more than 40% of cases
data.sql: SELECT d.diagnosis_coded, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.certainty = 'PRESUMED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as presumed_rate FROM diagnosis d JOIN encounter_diagnosis ed ON d.diagnosis_id = ed.diagnosis_id WHERE d.diagnosis_coded IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.diagnosis_coded HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN d.certainty = 'PRESUMED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > 40

data.input: schema: notification_alert_recipient(alert_recipient_id(INT), alert_id(INT), user_id(INT), alert_read(BOOLEAN)) | question: Utilisateurs avec plus de 20 alertes non lues
data.sql: SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) as unread_alerts FROM notification_alert_recipient WHERE alert_read = FALSE GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 20

data.input: schema: concept_numeric(concept_id(INT), hi_critical(DECIMAL), low_critical(DECIMAL)), obs(obs_id(INT), concept_id(INT), value_numeric(DECIMAL)) | question: Numeric concepts with more than 15% critical values
data.sql: SELECT cn.concept_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.value_numeric < cn.low_critical OR o.value_numeric > cn.hi_critical THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as critical_rate FROM concept_numeric cn JOIN obs o ON cn.concept_id = o.concept_id WHERE o.value_numeric IS NOT NULL AND cn.low_critical IS NOT NULL AND cn.hi_critical IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cn.concept_id HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN o.value_numeric < cn.low_critical OR o.value_numeric > cn.hi_critical THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > 15

data.input: schema: report_definition(report_definition_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), report_request(request_id(INT), report_definition_id(INT), status(VARCHAR)) | question: Définitions de rapport avec taux d'échec supérieur à 20%
data.sql: SELECT rd.name, COUNT(CASE WHEN rr.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as failure_rate FROM report_definition rd JOIN report_request rr ON rd.report_definition_id = rr.report_definition_id GROUP BY rd.report_definition_id, rd.name HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN rr.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > 20

data.input: schema: drug_order(order_id(INT), drug_inventory_id(INT), as_needed(BOOLEAN), dose(DECIMAL)) | question: PRN drugs with average dose exceeding 100mg
data.sql: SELECT drug_inventory_id, AVG(dose) as avg_dose FROM drug_order WHERE as_needed = TRUE AND dose IS NOT NULL GROUP BY drug_inventory_id HAVING AVG(dose) > 100

data.input: schema: form(form_id(INT), version(VARCHAR)), form_field(form_field_id(INT), form_id(INT)), encounter(encounter_id(INT), form_id(INT)) | question: Versions de formulaire avec plus de 20 champs et utilisées dans plus de 100 consultations
data.sql: SELECT f.form_id, f.version, COUNT(DISTINCT ff.form_field_id) as field_count, COUNT(DISTINCT e.encounter_id) as encounter_count FROM form f LEFT JOIN form_field ff ON f.form_id = ff.form_id LEFT JOIN encounter e ON f.form_id = e.form_id GROUP BY f.form_id, f.version HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ff.form_field_id) > 20 AND COUNT(DISTINCT e.encounter_id) > 100

data.input: schema: global_property(property(VARCHAR), property_value(TEXT), description(TEXT)) | question: Property categories with more than 10 properties (grouped by prefix)
data.sql: SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(property, '.', 1) as property_category, COUNT(*) as property_count FROM global_property GROUP BY property_category HAVING COUNT(*) > 10

data.input: schema: visit(visit_id(INT), patient_id(INT), visit_type_id(INT)), obs(obs_id(INT), encounter_id(INT)), encounter(encounter_id(INT), visit_id(INT)) | question: Types de visite avec plus de 50 observations par visite en moyenne
data.sql: SELECT v.visit_type_id, COUNT(o.obs_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT v.visit_id) as avg_obs_per_visit FROM visit v LEFT JOIN encounter e ON v.visit_id = e.visit_id LEFT JOIN obs o ON e.encounter_id = o.encounter_id GROUP BY v.visit_type_id HAVING COUNT(o.obs_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT v.visit_id) > 50

data.input: schema: liquibasechangelog(id(VARCHAR), author(VARCHAR), filename(VARCHAR), dateexecuted(DATETIME)) | question: Authors with more than 20 changesets executed this year
data.sql: SELECT author, COUNT(*) as changeset_count FROM liquibasechangelog WHERE YEAR(dateexecuted) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY author HAVING COUNT(*) > 20

data.input: schema: hl7_in_queue(hl7_in_queue_id(INT), hl7_source(INT), message_state(INT)), hl7_source(hl7_source_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)) | question: Sources HL7 avec plus de 100 messages en file d'attente
data.sql: SELECT hs.name, COUNT(hiq.hl7_in_queue_id) as queue_count FROM hl7_source hs JOIN hl7_in_queue hiq ON hs.hl7_source_id = hiq.hl7_source GROUP BY hs.hl7_source_id, hs.name HAVING COUNT(hiq.hl7_in_queue_id) > 100

data.input: schema: patient_program_attribute(attribute_id(INT), patient_program_id(INT), attribute_type_id(INT), value_reference(TEXT)) | question: Program enrollment attributes with more than 50% null values
data.sql: SELECT attribute_type_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN value_reference IS NULL THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as null_rate FROM patient_program_attribute GROUP BY attribute_type_id HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN value_reference IS NULL THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > 50

data.input: schema: encounter_provider(encounter_provider_id(INT), encounter_id(INT), provider_id(INT), encounter_role_id(INT)), encounter(encounter_id(INT), encounter_datetime(DATETIME)) | question: Prestataires avec plus de 20 consultations par jour en moyenne
data.sql: SELECT ep.provider_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.encounter_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(e.encounter_datetime)) as avg_daily_encounters FROM encounter_provider ep JOIN encounter e ON ep.encounter_id = e.encounter_id WHERE e.encounter_datetime IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ep.provider_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.encounter_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(e.encounter_datetime)) > 20

data.input: schema: patient(patient_id(INT), given_name(VARCHAR), family_name(VARCHAR)), person(person_id(INT), gender(VARCHAR), birthdate(DATE)) | question: Informations complètes des patients avec leur genre et date de naissance
data.sql: SELECT p.given_name, p.family_name, pe.gender, pe.birthdate FROM patient p INNER JOIN person pe ON p.patient_id = pe.person_id

data.input: schema: encounter(encounter_id(INT), patient_id(INT), encounter_type(INT), encounter_datetime(DATETIME)), encounter_type(encounter_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)) | question: All encounters with their type names
data.sql: SELECT e.encounter_id, e.encounter_datetime, et.name as encounter_type_name FROM encounter e INNER JOIN encounter_type et ON e.encounter_type = et.encounter_type_id

data.input: schema: visit(visit_id(INT), patient_id(INT), visit_type_id(INT), location_id(INT)), location(location_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), address1(VARCHAR)) | question: Visites avec nom et adresse de la location
data.sql: SELECT v.visit_id, v.patient_id, l.name as location_name, l.address1 FROM visit v LEFT JOIN location l ON v.location_id = l.location_id

data.input: schema: orders(order_id(INT), patient_id(INT), concept_id(INT), orderer(INT)), provider(provider_id(INT), person_id(INT), identifier(VARCHAR)) | question: Orders with provider identifier who ordered them
data.sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.patient_id, p.identifier as provider_identifier FROM orders o INNER JOIN provider p ON o.orderer = p.provider_id

data.input: schema: drug_order(order_id(INT), drug_inventory_id(INT), dose(DECIMAL), frequency(INT)), drug(drug_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), concept_id(INT)) | question: Prescriptions de médicaments avec nom du médicament
data.sql: SELECT do.order_id, do.dose, d.name as drug_name FROM drug_order do INNER JOIN drug d ON do.drug_inventory_id = d.drug_id

data.input: schema: obs(obs_id(INT), person_id(INT), concept_id(INT), value_numeric(DECIMAL)), concept(concept_id(INT), datatype_id(INT), is_set(BOOLEAN)) | question: Numeric observations for non-set concepts
data.sql: SELECT o.obs_id, o.value_numeric, c.concept_id FROM obs o INNER JOIN concept c ON o.concept_id = c.concept_id WHERE c.is_set = FALSE AND o.value_numeric IS NOT NULL

data.input: schema: patient_program(patient_program_id(INT), patient_id(INT), program_id(INT), date_enrolled(DATE)), program(program_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), description(TEXT)) | question: Inscriptions aux programmes avec détails du programme
data.sql: SELECT pp.patient_program_id, pp.patient_id, pp.date_enrolled, p.name as program_name, p.description FROM patient_program pp INNER JOIN program p ON pp.program_id = p.program_id

data.input: schema: allergy(allergy_id(INT), patient_id(INT), allergen(VARCHAR), severity(VARCHAR)), patient(patient_id(INT), given_name(VARCHAR), family_name(VARCHAR)) | question: Patient allergies with patient names
data.sql: SELECT p.given_name, p.family_name, a.allergen, a.severity FROM allergy a INNER JOIN patient p ON a.patient_id = p.patient_id

data.input: schema: cohort(cohort_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), description(TEXT)), cohort_member(cohort_member_id(INT), cohort_id(INT), patient_id(INT), start_date(DATE)) | question: Membres de cohorte avec détails de la cohorte
data.sql: SELECT cm.patient_id, cm.start_date, c.name as cohort_name, c.description FROM cohort_member cm INNER JOIN cohort c ON cm.cohort_id = c.cohort_id

data.input: schema: person_address(person_address_id(INT), person_id(INT), city_village(VARCHAR), state_province(VARCHAR)), person(person_id(INT), gender(VARCHAR)) | question: Addresses with person gender
data.sql: SELECT pa.city_village, pa.state_province, p.gender FROM person_address pa INNER JOIN person p ON pa.person_id = p.person_id

data.input: schema: relationship(relationship_id(INT), person_a(INT), person_b(INT), relationship(INT)), relationship_type(relationship_type_id(INT), a_is_to_b(VARCHAR), b_is_to_a(VARCHAR)) | question: Relations avec description du type de relation
data.sql: SELECT r.person_a, r.person_b, rt.a_is_to_b as relationship_description FROM relationship r INNER JOIN relationship_type rt ON r.relationship = rt.relationship_type_id

data.input: schema: patient_identifier(patient_identifier_id(INT), patient_id(INT), identifier(VARCHAR), identifier_type(INT)), patient_identifier_type(patient_identifier_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), format(VARCHAR)) | question: Patient identifiers with type details
data.sql: SELECT pi.patient_id, pi.identifier, pit.name as identifier_type_name, pit.format FROM patient_identifier pi INNER JOIN patient_identifier_type pit ON pi.identifier_type = pit.patient_identifier_type_id

data.input: schema: form(form_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), version(VARCHAR), published(BOOLEAN)), encounter(encounter_id(INT), patient_id(INT), form_id(INT)) | question: Consultations avec détails du formulaire utilisé
data.sql: SELECT e.encounter_id, e.patient_id, f.name as form_name, f.version FROM encounter e LEFT JOIN form f ON e.form_id = f.form_id

data.input: schema: concept_class(concept_class_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), description(TEXT)), concept(concept_id(INT), class_id(INT), retired(BOOLEAN)) | question: Active concepts with their class names
data.sql: SELECT c.concept_id, cc.name as class_name, cc.description FROM concept c INNER JOIN concept_class cc ON c.class_id = cc.concept_class_id WHERE c.retired = FALSE

data.input: schema: visit_type(visit_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), description(TEXT)), visit(visit_id(INT), patient_id(INT), visit_type_id(INT), date_started(DATETIME)) | question: Visites de cette semaine avec type de visite
data.sql: SELECT v.visit_id, v.patient_id, v.date_started, vt.name as visit_type FROM visit v INNER JOIN visit_type vt ON v.visit_type_id = vt.visit_type_id WHERE v.date_started >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)

data.input: schema: users(user_id(INT), username(VARCHAR), person_id(INT)), person(person_id(INT), gender(VARCHAR), birthdate(DATE)) | question: User accounts with person demographics
data.sql: SELECT u.username, p.gender, p.birthdate FROM users u INNER JOIN person p ON u.person_id = p.person_id

data.input: schema: encounter_provider(encounter_provider_id(INT), encounter_id(INT), provider_id(INT), encounter_role_id(INT)), encounter_role(encounter_role_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)) | question: Prestataires de consultation avec leur rôle
data.sql: SELECT ep.encounter_id, ep.provider_id, er.name as role_name FROM encounter_provider ep INNER JOIN encounter_role er ON ep.encounter_role_id = er.encounter_role_id

data.input: schema: care_setting(care_setting_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), care_setting_type(VARCHAR)), orders(order_id(INT), patient_id(INT), care_setting(INT)) | question: Orders with care setting details
data.sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.patient_id, cs.name as care_setting_name, cs.care_setting_type FROM orders o INNER JOIN care_setting cs ON o.care_setting = cs.care_setting_id

data.input: schema: conditions(condition_id(INT), patient_id(INT), condition_coded(INT), clinical_status(VARCHAR)), concept(concept_id(INT), uuid(VARCHAR)) | question: Conditions actives avec UUID du concept
data.sql: SELECT co.condition_id, co.patient_id, co.clinical_status, c.uuid as concept_uuid FROM conditions co INNER JOIN concept c ON co.condition_coded = c.concept_id WHERE co.clinical_status = 'ACTIVE'

data.input: schema: test_order(order_id(INT), specimen_source(INT), specimen_number(VARCHAR)), concept(concept_id(INT), uuid(VARCHAR)) | question: Test orders with specimen source concept details
data.sql: SELECT t.order_id, t.specimen_number, c.uuid as specimen_source_uuid FROM test_order t LEFT JOIN concept c ON t.specimen_source = c.concept_id

data.input: schema: appointment(appointment_id(INT), patient_id(INT), appointment_type_id(INT), status(VARCHAR)), appointment_type(appointment_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), duration(INT)) | question: Rendez-vous confirmés avec durée prévue
data.sql: SELECT a.appointment_id, a.patient_id, at.name as appointment_type, at.duration FROM appointment a INNER JOIN appointment_type at ON a.appointment_type_id = at.appointment_type_id WHERE a.status = 'CONFIRMED'

data.input: schema: patient_state(patient_state_id(INT), patient_program_id(INT), state(INT), start_date(DATE)), program_workflow_state(program_workflow_state_id(INT), concept_id(INT)) | question: Patient states with associated concept
data.sql: SELECT ps.patient_state_id, ps.patient_program_id, ps.start_date, pws.concept_id FROM patient_state ps INNER JOIN program_workflow_state pws ON ps.state = pws.program_workflow_state_id

data.input: schema: person_name(person_name_id(INT), person_id(INT), given_name(VARCHAR), family_name(VARCHAR), preferred(BOOLEAN)), person(person_id(INT), dead(BOOLEAN)) | question: Noms préférés des personnes vivantes
data.sql: SELECT pn.given_name, pn.family_name, pn.person_id FROM person_name pn INNER JOIN person p ON pn.person_id = p.person_id WHERE pn.preferred = TRUE AND p.dead = FALSE

data.input: schema: provider(provider_id(INT), person_id(INT), provider_role_id(INT)), provider_role(provider_role_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), description(TEXT)) | question: Providers with their role descriptions
data.sql: SELECT p.provider_id, p.person_id, pr.name as role_name, pr.description FROM provider p LEFT JOIN provider_role pr ON p.provider_role_id = pr.provider_role_id

data.input: schema: person_attribute(person_attribute_id(INT), person_id(INT), value(VARCHAR), attribute_type_id(INT)), person_attribute_type(person_attribute_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), format(VARCHAR)) | question: Attributs de personne avec nom du type
data.sql: SELECT pa.person_id, pa.value, pat.name as attribute_type FROM person_attribute pa INNER JOIN person_attribute_type pat ON pa.attribute_type_id = pat.person_attribute_type_id

data.input: schema: concept_datatype(concept_datatype_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), hl7_abbreviation(VARCHAR)), concept(concept_id(INT), datatype_id(INT)) | question: Concepts with their datatype HL7 abbreviation
data.sql: SELECT c.concept_id, cd.name as datatype_name, cd.hl7_abbreviation FROM concept c INNER JOIN concept_datatype cd ON c.datatype_id = cd.concept_datatype_id

data.input: schema: location_tag(location_tag_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), description(TEXT)), location_tag_map(location_id(INT), location_tag_id(INT)) | question: Locations avec leurs tags
data.sql: SELECT ltm.location_id, lt.name as tag_name, lt.description FROM location_tag_map ltm INNER JOIN location_tag lt ON ltm.location_tag_id = lt.location_tag_id

data.input: schema: order_type(order_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), java_class_name(VARCHAR)), orders(order_id(INT), order_type_id(INT), discontinued(BOOLEAN)) | question: Active orders with their type class names
data.sql: SELECT o.order_id, ot.name as order_type, ot.java_class_name FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_type ot ON o.order_type_id = ot.order_type_id WHERE o.discontinued = FALSE

data.input: schema: diagnosis(diagnosis_id(INT), patient_id(INT), diagnosis_coded(INT), certainty(VARCHAR)), concept_name(concept_name_id(INT), concept_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), locale(VARCHAR)) | question: Diagnostics confirmés avec nom du concept en français
data.sql: SELECT d.diagnosis_id, d.patient_id, cn.name as diagnosis_name FROM diagnosis d INNER JOIN concept_name cn ON d.diagnosis_coded = cn.concept_id WHERE d.certainty = 'CONFIRMED' AND cn.locale = 'fr'

data.input: schema: encounter_diagnosis(encounter_diagnosis_id(INT), diagnosis_id(INT), encounter_id(INT), rank(INT)), diagnosis(diagnosis_id(INT), diagnosis_coded(INT)) | question: Primary encounter diagnoses with coded value
data.sql: SELECT ed.encounter_id, ed.encounter_diagnosis_id, d.diagnosis_coded FROM encounter_diagnosis ed INNER JOIN diagnosis d ON ed.diagnosis_id = d.diagnosis_id WHERE ed.rank = 1

data.input: schema: drug_reference_map(drug_reference_map_id(INT), drug_id(INT), term_id(INT)), concept_reference_term(concept_reference_term_id(INT), code(VARCHAR), name(VARCHAR)) | question: Mappings de médicaments avec code de référence
data.sql: SELECT drm.drug_id, crt.code, crt.name as term_name FROM drug_reference_map drm INNER JOIN concept_reference_term crt ON drm.term_id = crt.concept_reference_term_id

data.input: schema: form_field(form_field_id(INT), form_id(INT), field_id(INT), field_number(INT)), field(field_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), description(TEXT)) | question: Form fields with field details ordered by number
data.sql: SELECT ff.form_id, ff.field_number, f.name as field_name, f.description FROM form_field ff INNER JOIN field f ON ff.field_id = f.field_id ORDER BY ff.form_id, ff.field_number

data.input: schema: patient_program_attribute(attribute_id(INT), patient_program_id(INT), attribute_type_id(INT), value_reference(TEXT)), program_attribute_type(program_attribute_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)) | question: Attributs de programme patient avec nom du type
data.sql: SELECT ppa.patient_program_id, ppa.value_reference, pat.name as attribute_type FROM patient_program_attribute ppa INNER JOIN program_attribute_type pat ON ppa.attribute_type_id = pat.program_attribute_type_id

data.input: schema: order_frequency(order_frequency_id(INT), concept_id(INT)), drug_order(order_id(INT), frequency(INT), dose(DECIMAL)) | question: Drug orders with frequency concept
data.sql: SELECT do.order_id, do.dose, of.concept_id as frequency_concept FROM drug_order do LEFT JOIN order_frequency of ON do.frequency = of.order_frequency_id

data.input: schema: note(note_id(INT), patient_id(INT), note_type(INT), text(TEXT)), concept(concept_id(INT), uuid(VARCHAR)) | question: Notes patient avec UUID du type de note
data.sql: SELECT n.note_id, n.patient_id, n.text, c.uuid as note_type_uuid FROM note n LEFT JOIN concept c ON n.note_type = c.concept_id

data.input: schema: program_workflow(program_workflow_id(INT), program_id(INT), concept_id(INT)), concept_name(concept_name_id(INT), concept_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)) | question: Program workflows with concept names
data.sql: SELECT pw.program_workflow_id, pw.program_id, cn.name as workflow_concept_name FROM program_workflow pw INNER JOIN concept_name cn ON pw.concept_id = cn.concept_id WHERE cn.locale_preferred = TRUE

data.input: schema: obs(obs_id(INT), concept_id(INT), value_coded(INT), obs_datetime(DATETIME)), concept(concept_id(INT), is_set(BOOLEAN)) | question: Observations de cette année pour concepts non-ensemble
data.sql: SELECT o.obs_id, o.obs_datetime, o.value_coded FROM obs o INNER JOIN concept c ON o.concept_id = c.concept_id WHERE c.is_set = FALSE AND YEAR(o.obs_datetime) = YEAR(CURDATE())

data.input: schema: provider_attribute(provider_attribute_id(INT), provider_id(INT), attribute_type_id(INT), value_reference(TEXT)), provider_attribute_type(provider_attribute_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), datatype(VARCHAR)) | question: Provider attributes with datatype information
data.sql: SELECT pa.provider_id, pa.value_reference, pat.name as attribute_name, pat.datatype FROM provider_attribute pa INNER JOIN provider_attribute_type pat ON pa.attribute_type_id = pat.provider_attribute_type_id

data.input: schema: visit_attribute(attribute_id(INT), visit_id(INT), attribute_type_id(INT), value_reference(TEXT)), visit_attribute_type(visit_attribute_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), min_occurs(INT)) | question: Attributs de visite obligatoires
