data.input: schema: patient_program_attribute(attribute_id(INT), patient_program_id(INT), attribute_type_id(INT)), program_attribute_type(program_attribute_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), patient_program(patient_program_id(INT), patient_id(INT), program_id(INT)), program(program_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)) | question: Attributs de programme patient avec nom du programme
data.sql: SELECT ppa.attribute_id, pat.name as attribute_type, p.name as program_name FROM patient_program_attribute ppa INNER JOIN program_attribute_type pat ON ppa.attribute_type_id = pat.program_attribute_type_id INNER JOIN patient_program pp ON ppa.patient_program_id = pp.patient_program_id INNER JOIN program p ON pp.program_id = p.program_id

data.input: schema: encounter_provider(encounter_provider_id(INT), encounter_id(INT), provider_id(INT)), encounter(encounter_id(INT), patient_id(INT), encounter_datetime(DATETIME)), provider(provider_id(INT), identifier(VARCHAR)), patient(patient_id(INT), given_name(VARCHAR)) | question: Today's encounters with provider and patient names
data.sql: SELECT e.encounter_datetime, p.given_name as patient_name, pr.identifier as provider_id FROM encounter_provider ep INNER JOIN encounter e ON ep.encounter_id = e.encounter_id INNER JOIN provider pr ON ep.provider_id = pr.provider_id INNER JOIN patient p ON e.patient_id = p.patient_id WHERE DATE(e.encounter_datetime) = CURDATE()

data.input: schema: concept_complex(concept_id(INT), handler(VARCHAR)), obs(obs_id(INT), concept_id(INT), value_complex(VARCHAR), encounter_id(INT)), encounter(encounter_id(INT), patient_id(INT)), patient(patient_id(INT), given_name(VARCHAR)) | question: Observations complexes avec gestionnaire et patient
data.sql: SELECT o.obs_id, cc.handler, p.given_name FROM concept_complex cc INNER JOIN obs o ON cc.concept_id = o.concept_id INNER JOIN encounter e ON o.encounter_id = e.encounter_id INNER JOIN patient p ON e.patient_id = p.patient_id WHERE o.value_complex IS NOT NULL

data.input: schema: liquibasechangelog(id(VARCHAR), author(VARCHAR), filename(VARCHAR)), databasechangelog(id(VARCHAR), author(VARCHAR)), users(user_id(INT), username(VARCHAR), system_id(VARCHAR)) | question: Changelog entries with matching system user
data.sql: SELECT l.id, l.author, l.filename, u.username FROM liquibasechangelog l INNER JOIN databasechangelog d ON l.id = d.id AND l.author = d.author LEFT JOIN users u ON l.author = u.system_id

data.input: schema: encounter_type(encounter_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), edit_privilege(VARCHAR)), privilege(privilege(VARCHAR), description(TEXT)), encounter(encounter_id(INT), encounter_type(INT), patient_id(INT)), patient(patient_id(INT), given_name(VARCHAR)) | question: Consultations avec privilège d'édition et patient
data.sql: SELECT e.encounter_id, et.name as encounter_type, pr.description as privilege_desc, p.given_name FROM encounter e INNER JOIN encounter_type et ON e.encounter_type = et.encounter_type_id LEFT JOIN privilege pr ON et.edit_privilege = pr.privilege INNER JOIN patient p ON e.patient_id = p.patient_id

data.input: schema: person(person_id(INT), birthdate(DATE), birthdate_estimated(BOOLEAN)), patient(patient_id(INT)), patient_identifier(patient_identifier_id(INT), patient_id(INT), identifier(VARCHAR), identifier_type(INT)), patient_identifier_type(patient_identifier_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)) | question: Patients with estimated birthdates and their identifiers
data.sql: SELECT pe.birthdate, pi.identifier, pit.name as identifier_type FROM person pe INNER JOIN patient p ON pe.person_id = p.patient_id INNER JOIN patient_identifier pi ON p.patient_id = pi.patient_id INNER JOIN patient_identifier_type pit ON pi.identifier_type = pit.patient_identifier_type_id WHERE pe.birthdate_estimated = TRUE

data.input: schema: location(location_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), parent_location(INT)), encounter(encounter_id(INT), location_id(INT), patient_id(INT)), patient(patient_id(INT), given_name(VARCHAR)), location parent(location_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)) | question: Consultations dans sous-locations avec nom du parent
data.sql: SELECT e.encounter_id, p.given_name, l.name as location_name, lp.name as parent_location_name FROM encounter e INNER JOIN location l ON e.location_id = l.location_id INNER JOIN location lp ON l.parent_location = lp.location_id INNER JOIN patient p ON e.patient_id = p.patient_id

data.input: schema: role(role(VARCHAR), description(TEXT)), user_role(user_id(INT), role(VARCHAR)), users(user_id(INT), username(VARCHAR), person_id(INT)), person(person_id(INT), gender(VARCHAR)) | question: User roles with gender distribution
data.sql: SELECT r.role, r.description, u.username, p.gender FROM role r INNER JOIN user_role ur ON r.role = ur.role INNER JOIN users u ON ur.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN person p ON u.person_id = p.person_id

data.input: schema: drug(drug_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), maximum_daily_dose(DECIMAL)), drug_order(order_id(INT), drug_inventory_id(INT), dose(DECIMAL)), orders(order_id(INT), patient_id(INT)), patient(patient_id(INT), given_name(VARCHAR)) | question: Prescriptions dépassant la dose maximale avec patient
data.sql: SELECT p.given_name, d.name as drug_name, do.dose, d.maximum_daily_dose FROM drug_order do INNER JOIN drug d ON do.drug_inventory_id = d.drug_id INNER JOIN orders o ON do.order_id = o.order_id INNER JOIN patient p ON o.patient_id = p.patient_id WHERE do.dose > d.maximum_daily_dose

data.input: schema: orders(order_id(INT), encounter_id(INT), scheduled_date(DATE)), encounter(encounter_id(INT), visit_id(INT), patient_id(INT)), visit(visit_id(INT), visit_type_id(INT)), visit_type(visit_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)) | question: Scheduled orders with visit type
data.sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.scheduled_date, vt.name as visit_type FROM orders o INNER JOIN encounter e ON o.encounter_id = e.encounter_id INNER JOIN visit v ON e.visit_id = v.visit_id INNER JOIN visit_type vt ON v.visit_type_id = vt.visit_type_id WHERE o.scheduled_date >= CURDATE()

data.input: schema: program_attribute_type(program_attribute_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), program_id(INT)), program(program_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), patient_program(patient_program_id(INT), program_id(INT), patient_id(INT)), patient_program_attribute(attribute_id(INT), patient_program_id(INT), attribute_type_id(INT)) | question: Attributs utilisés par programme
data.sql: SELECT p.name as program_name, pat.name as attribute_type, COUNT(ppa.attribute_id) as usage_count FROM program_attribute_type pat INNER JOIN program p ON pat.program_id = p.program_id LEFT JOIN patient_program pp ON p.program_id = pp.program_id LEFT JOIN patient_program_attribute ppa ON pp.patient_program_id = ppa.patient_program_id AND pat.program_attribute_type_id = ppa.attribute_type_id GROUP BY p.program_id, p.name, pat.program_attribute_type_id, pat.name

data.input: schema: drug_order(order_id(INT), route(INT), dose_units(INT)), concept route_concept(concept_id(INT), uuid(VARCHAR)), concept units_concept(concept_id(INT), uuid(VARCHAR)), orders(order_id(INT), patient_id(INT)) | question: Drug orders with route and unit concepts
data.sql: SELECT do.order_id, o.patient_id, cr.uuid as route_uuid, cu.uuid as units_uuid FROM drug_order do INNER JOIN orders o ON do.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN concept cr ON do.route = cr.concept_id LEFT JOIN concept cu ON do.dose_units = cu.concept_id

data.input: schema: person_merge_log(person_merge_log_id(INT), winner_person_id(INT), loser_person_id(INT)), person winner(person_id(INT), gender(VARCHAR)), person loser(person_id(INT), birthdate(DATE)), patient(patient_id(INT)) | question: Fusions de personnes avec détails des deux côtés
data.sql: SELECT pml.person_merge_log_id, pw.gender as winner_gender, pl.birthdate as loser_birthdate FROM person_merge_log pml INNER JOIN person pw ON pml.winner_person_id = pw.person_id INNER JOIN person pl ON pml.loser_person_id = pl.person_id LEFT JOIN patient p ON pw.person_id = p.patient_id

data.input: schema: conditions(condition_id(INT), patient_id(INT), condition_coded(INT), onset_date(DATE)), concept_name(concept_name_id(INT), concept_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), patient(patient_id(INT), given_name(VARCHAR)), person(person_id(INT), birthdate(DATE)) | question: Patient conditions with onset age
data.sql: SELECT p.given_name, cn.name as condition_name, co.onset_date, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, pe.birthdate, co.onset_date) as onset_age FROM conditions co INNER JOIN patient p ON co.patient_id = p.patient_id INNER JOIN person pe ON p.patient_id = pe.person_id INNER JOIN concept_name cn ON co.condition_coded = cn.concept_id WHERE co.onset_date IS NOT NULL AND pe.birthdate IS NOT NULL

data.input: schema: test_order(order_id(INT), clinical_history(TEXT), frequency(INT)), orders(order_id(INT), patient_id(INT), concept_id(INT)), concept_name(concept_name_id(INT), concept_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), order_frequency(order_frequency_id(INT), concept_id(INT)) | question: Tests avec historique et fréquence nommée
data.sql: SELECT t.order_id, t.clinical_history, cn.name as test_name, of.concept_id as frequency_concept FROM test_order t INNER JOIN orders o ON t.order_id = o.order_id INNER JOIN concept_name cn ON o.concept_id = cn.concept_id LEFT JOIN order_frequency of ON t.frequency = of.order_frequency_id

data.input: schema: encounter_attribute(attribute_id(INT), encounter_id(INT), attribute_type_id(INT)), encounter_attribute_type(encounter_attribute_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), encounter(encounter_id(INT), patient_id(INT), encounter_type(INT)), encounter_type(encounter_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)) | question: Encounter attributes with encounter type
data.sql: SELECT ea.attribute_id, eat.name as attribute_type, et.name as encounter_type FROM encounter_attribute ea INNER JOIN encounter_attribute_type eat ON ea.attribute_type_id = eat.encounter_attribute_type_id INNER JOIN encounter e ON ea.encounter_id = e.encounter_id INNER JOIN encounter_type et ON e.encounter_type = et.encounter_type_id

data.input: schema: order_group_attribute(order_group_attribute_id(INT), order_group_id(INT), attribute_type_id(INT)), order_group_attribute_type(order_group_attribute_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), order_group(order_group_id(INT), patient_id(INT)), patient(patient_id(INT), given_name(VARCHAR)) | question: Attributs de groupe avec nom du patient
data.sql: SELECT oga.order_group_attribute_id, ogat.name as attribute_type, p.given_name FROM order_group_attribute oga INNER JOIN order_group_attribute_type ogat ON oga.attribute_type_id = ogat.order_group_attribute_type_id INNER JOIN order_group og ON oga.order_group_id = og.order_group_id INNER JOIN patient p ON og.patient_id = p.patient_id

data.input: schema: visit(visit_id(INT), patient_id(INT), indication_concept_id(INT)), concept_name(concept_name_id(INT), concept_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), patient(patient_id(INT), given_name(VARCHAR)), person(person_id(INT), gender(VARCHAR)) | question: Visit indications by patient gender
data.sql: SELECT v.visit_id, p.given_name, pe.gender, cn.name as indication FROM visit v INNER JOIN patient p ON v.patient_id = p.patient_id INNER JOIN person pe ON p.patient_id = pe.person_id LEFT JOIN concept_name cn ON v.indication_concept_id = cn.concept_id

data.input: schema: person(person_id(INT), cause_of_death(INT), death_date(DATE)), concept_name(concept_name_id(INT), concept_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), patient(patient_id(INT)), patient_identifier(patient_identifier_id(INT), patient_id(INT), identifier(VARCHAR)) | question: Décès avec cause et identifiant patient
data.sql: SELECT pi.identifier, pe.death_date, cn.name as cause_of_death FROM person pe INNER JOIN patient p ON pe.person_id = p.patient_id INNER JOIN patient_identifier pi ON p.patient_id = pi.patient_id INNER JOIN concept_name cn ON pe.cause_of_death = cn.concept_id WHERE pe.cause_of_death IS NOT NULL AND pi.preferred = TRUE

data.input: schema: allergy(allergy_id(INT), patient_id(INT), coded_allergen(INT), severity(VARCHAR)), concept(concept_id(INT), class_id(INT)), concept_class(concept_class_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), patient(patient_id(INT), given_name(VARCHAR)) | question: Severe allergies by allergen class
data.sql: SELECT p.given_name, a.severity, cc.name as allergen_class FROM allergy a INNER JOIN patient p ON a.patient_id = p.patient_id INNER JOIN concept c ON a.coded_allergen = c.concept_id INNER JOIN concept_class cc ON c.class_id = cc.concept_class_id WHERE a.severity = 'SEVERE'

data.input: schema: patient_state(patient_state_id(INT), patient_program_id(INT), state(INT), start_date(DATE)), patient_program(patient_program_id(INT), patient_id(INT), program_id(INT)), program(program_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), program_workflow_state(program_workflow_state_id(INT), terminal(BOOLEAN)) | question: États terminaux par programme
data.sql: SELECT p.name as program_name, ps.start_date, pws.terminal FROM patient_state ps INNER JOIN patient_program pp ON ps.patient_program_id = pp.patient_program_id INNER JOIN program p ON pp.program_id = p.program_id INNER JOIN program_workflow_state pws ON ps.state = pws.program_workflow_state_id WHERE pws.terminal = TRUE

data.input: schema: drug(drug_id(INT), concept_id(INT), retire_reason(INT)), concept drug_concept(concept_id(INT), uuid(VARCHAR)), concept retire_concept(concept_id(INT), uuid(VARCHAR)), concept_name(concept_name_id(INT), concept_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)) | question: Retired drugs with concept and reason
data.sql: SELECT d.drug_id, cd.uuid as drug_concept_uuid, cr.uuid as retire_reason_uuid, cn.name as retire_reason_name FROM drug d INNER JOIN concept cd ON d.concept_id = cd.concept_id INNER JOIN concept cr ON d.retire_reason = cr.concept_id INNER JOIN concept_name cn ON cr.concept_id = cn.concept_id WHERE d.retire_reason IS NOT NULL

data.input: schema: location_attribute(attribute_id(INT), location_id(INT), attribute_type_id(INT)), location_attribute_type(location_attribute_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), location(location_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), encounter(encounter_id(INT), location_id(INT)) | question: Attributs de location avec nombre de consultations
data.sql: SELECT l.name as location_name, lat.name as attribute_type, COUNT(e.encounter_id) as encounter_count FROM location_attribute la INNER JOIN location_attribute_type lat ON la.attribute_type_id = lat.location_attribute_type_id INNER JOIN location l ON la.location_id = l.location_id LEFT JOIN encounter e ON l.location_id = e.location_id GROUP BY l.location_id, l.name, lat.location_attribute_type_id, lat.name

data.input: schema: reporting_report_design(id(INT), name(VARCHAR), report_definition_id(INT)), report_definition(report_definition_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), report_request(request_id(INT), report_definition_id(INT), status(VARCHAR)) | question: Report designs with request status distribution
data.sql: SELECT rrd.name as design_name, rd.name as definition_name, rr.status, COUNT(rr.request_id) as request_count FROM reporting_report_design rrd INNER JOIN report_definition rd ON rrd.report_definition_id = rd.report_definition_id LEFT JOIN report_request rr ON rd.report_definition_id = rr.report_definition_id GROUP BY rrd.id, rrd.name, rd.report_definition_id, rd.name, rr.status

data.input: schema: concept_state_conversion(concept_state_conversion_id(INT), concept_id(INT), program_workflow_id(INT)), program_workflow(program_workflow_id(INT), program_id(INT)), program(program_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), concept_name(concept_name_id(INT), concept_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)) | question: Conversions d'état avec programme et concept
data.sql: SELECT p.name as program_name, cn.name as concept_name FROM concept_state_conversion csc INNER JOIN program_workflow pw ON csc.program_workflow_id = pw.program_workflow_id INNER JOIN program p ON pw.program_id = p.program_id INNER JOIN concept_name cn ON csc.concept_id = cn.concept_id

data.input: schema: patient(patient_id(INT), given_name(VARCHAR)), encounter(encounter_id(INT), patient_id(INT), encounter_datetime(DATETIME)) | question: Patients ayant eu des consultations ce mois
data.sql: SELECT given_name FROM patient WHERE patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM encounter WHERE MONTH(encounter_datetime) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(encounter_datetime) = YEAR(CURDATE()))

data.input: schema: provider(provider_id(INT), identifier(VARCHAR)), encounter_provider(encounter_provider_id(INT), provider_id(INT), encounter_id(INT)) | question: Providers who have never done any encounters
data.sql: SELECT identifier FROM provider WHERE provider_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT provider_id FROM encounter_provider)

data.input: schema: drug(drug_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), drug_order(order_id(INT), drug_inventory_id(INT)) | question: Médicaments jamais prescrits
data.sql: SELECT name FROM drug WHERE drug_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT drug_inventory_id FROM drug_order)

data.input: schema: location(location_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), visit(visit_id(INT), location_id(INT), date_started(DATETIME)) | question: Locations with visits today
data.sql: SELECT name FROM location WHERE location_id IN (SELECT location_id FROM visit WHERE DATE(date_started) = CURDATE())

data.input: schema: concept(concept_id(INT), is_set(BOOLEAN)), obs(obs_id(INT), concept_id(INT), value_numeric(DECIMAL)) | question: Concepts ayant des valeurs numériques supérieures à la moyenne
data.sql: SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM obs WHERE value_numeric > (SELECT AVG(value_numeric) FROM obs WHERE value_numeric IS NOT NULL))

data.input: schema: patient_program(patient_program_id(INT), patient_id(INT), program_id(INT)), program(program_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)) | question: Programs with more than 100 enrollments
data.sql: SELECT name FROM program WHERE program_id IN (SELECT program_id FROM patient_program GROUP BY program_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 100)

data.input: schema: person(person_id(INT), birthdate(DATE)), allergy(allergy_id(INT), patient_id(INT)) | question: Âge moyen des patients sans allergies
data.sql: SELECT AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, birthdate, CURDATE())) as avg_age FROM person WHERE person_id NOT IN (SELECT patient_id FROM allergy)

data.input: schema: form(form_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), encounter(encounter_id(INT), form_id(INT)) | question: Most used form
data.sql: SELECT name FROM form WHERE form_id = (SELECT form_id FROM encounter GROUP BY form_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1)

data.input: schema: cohort(cohort_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), cohort_member(cohort_member_id(INT), cohort_id(INT), patient_id(INT)) | question: Cohortes avec plus de membres que la moyenne
data.sql: SELECT name FROM cohort WHERE cohort_id IN (SELECT cohort_id FROM cohort_member GROUP BY cohort_id HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT AVG(member_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as member_count FROM cohort_member GROUP BY cohort_id) as counts))

data.input: schema: users(user_id(INT), username(VARCHAR)), encounter(encounter_id(INT), creator(INT)) | question: Users who created encounters yesterday
data.sql: SELECT username FROM users WHERE user_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT creator FROM encounter WHERE DATE(date_created) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY))

data.input: schema: person_address(person_address_id(INT), person_id(INT), city_village(VARCHAR)), patient(patient_id(INT)) | question: Villes sans patients
data.sql: SELECT DISTINCT city_village FROM person_address WHERE person_id NOT IN (SELECT patient_id FROM patient)

data.input: schema: appointment_type(appointment_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), duration(INT)), appointment(appointment_id(INT), appointment_type_id(INT)) | question: Appointment types with above average duration
data.sql: SELECT name FROM appointment_type WHERE duration > (SELECT AVG(duration) FROM appointment_type WHERE duration IS NOT NULL)

data.input: schema: patient_identifier_type(patient_identifier_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), patient_identifier(patient_identifier_id(INT), identifier_type(INT)) | question: Types d'identifiants utilisés par plus de 1000 patients
data.sql: SELECT name FROM patient_identifier_type WHERE patient_identifier_type_id IN (SELECT identifier_type FROM patient_identifier GROUP BY identifier_type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) > 1000)

data.input: schema: encounter_type(encounter_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), encounter(encounter_id(INT), encounter_type(INT)) | question: Least used encounter type
data.sql: SELECT name FROM encounter_type WHERE encounter_type_id = (SELECT encounter_type FROM encounter GROUP BY encounter_type ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC LIMIT 1)

data.input: schema: diagnosis(diagnosis_id(INT), patient_id(INT), diagnosis_coded(INT)), concept(concept_id(INT), retired(BOOLEAN)) | question: Patients avec diagnostics de concepts retirés
data.sql: SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM diagnosis WHERE diagnosis_coded IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE retired = TRUE)

data.input: schema: care_setting(care_setting_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), orders(order_id(INT), care_setting(INT)) | question: Care settings never used for orders
data.sql: SELECT name FROM care_setting WHERE care_setting_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT care_setting FROM orders WHERE care_setting IS NOT NULL)

data.input: schema: test_order(order_id(INT), specimen_source(INT)), concept(concept_id(INT), class_id(INT)) | question: Sources d'échantillons de classe 4
data.sql: SELECT DISTINCT specimen_source FROM test_order WHERE specimen_source IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE class_id = 4)

data.input: schema: patient(patient_id(INT), given_name(VARCHAR)), orders(order_id(INT), patient_id(INT), date_activated(DATE)) | question: Patients with orders last month
data.sql: SELECT given_name FROM patient WHERE patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM orders WHERE date_activated >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH))

data.input: schema: note(note_id(INT), patient_id(INT), priority(INT)), patient(patient_id(INT), given_name(VARCHAR)) | question: Patients avec notes de priorité maximale
data.sql: SELECT given_name FROM patient WHERE patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM note WHERE priority = (SELECT MAX(priority) FROM note))

data.input: schema: program_workflow(program_workflow_id(INT), program_id(INT)), patient_state(patient_state_id(INT), patient_program_id(INT), state(INT)) | question: Workflows without any patient states
data.sql: SELECT program_workflow_id FROM program_workflow WHERE program_workflow_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT pws.program_workflow_id FROM program_workflow_state pws INNER JOIN patient_state ps ON pws.program_workflow_state_id = ps.state)

data.input: schema: drug_order(order_id(INT), drug_inventory_id(INT), dose(DECIMAL)), drug(drug_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)) | question: Médicaments avec dose moyenne supérieure à 100
data.sql: SELECT name FROM drug WHERE drug_id IN (SELECT drug_inventory_id FROM drug_order GROUP BY drug_inventory_id HAVING AVG(dose) > 100)

data.input: schema: location_tag(location_tag_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), location_tag_map(location_id(INT), location_tag_id(INT)) | question: Location tags applied to more than 5 locations
data.sql: SELECT name FROM location_tag WHERE location_tag_id IN (SELECT location_tag_id FROM location_tag_map GROUP BY location_tag_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 5)

data.input: schema: person_attribute_type(person_attribute_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), person_attribute(person_attribute_id(INT), attribute_type_id(INT)) | question: Types d'attributs jamais utilisés
data.sql: SELECT name FROM person_attribute_type WHERE person_attribute_type_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT attribute_type_id FROM person_attribute)

data.input: schema: order_type(order_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), orders(order_id(INT), order_type_id(INT), voided(BOOLEAN)) | question: Order types with no voided orders
data.sql: SELECT name FROM order_type WHERE order_type_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT order_type_id FROM orders WHERE voided = TRUE)

data.input: schema: field_type(field_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), field(field_id(INT), field_type(INT)) | question: Types de champs les plus utilisés
data.sql: SELECT name FROM field_type WHERE field_type_id = (SELECT field_type FROM field GROUP BY field_type ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1)

data.input: schema: provider_attribute_type(provider_attribute_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), provider_attribute(provider_attribute_id(INT), attribute_type_id(INT)) | question: Provider attribute types used by more than 10 providers
data.sql: SELECT name FROM provider_attribute_type WHERE provider_attribute_type_id IN (SELECT attribute_type_id FROM provider_attribute GROUP BY attribute_type_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT provider_id) > 10)

data.input: schema: visit_type(visit_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), visit(visit_id(INT), visit_type_id(INT), date_started(DATETIME)) | question: Types de visite utilisés cette semaine
data.sql: SELECT name FROM visit_type WHERE visit_type_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT visit_type_id FROM visit WHERE date_started >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY))

data.input: schema: order_set(order_set_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), order_set_member(order_set_member_id(INT), order_set_id(INT)) | question: Order sets with no members
data.sql: SELECT name FROM order_set WHERE order_set_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT order_set_id FROM order_set_member)

data.input: schema: concept_class(concept_class_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), concept(concept_id(INT), class_id(INT)) | question: Classes avec plus de 100 concepts
data.sql: SELECT name FROM concept_class WHERE concept_class_id IN (SELECT class_id FROM concept GROUP BY class_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 100)

data.input: schema: notification_alert(alert_id(INT), text(VARCHAR)), notification_alert_recipient(alert_recipient_id(INT), alert_id(INT), alert_read(BOOLEAN)) | question: Alerts with all recipients having read
data.sql: SELECT text FROM notification_alert WHERE alert_id NOT IN (SELECT alert_id FROM notification_alert_recipient WHERE alert_read = FALSE)

data.input: schema: relationship_type(relationship_type_id(INT), a_is_to_b(VARCHAR)), relationship(relationship_id(INT), relationship(INT)) | question: Types de relation jamais utilisés
data.sql: SELECT a_is_to_b FROM relationship_type WHERE relationship_type_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT relationship FROM relationship)

data.input: schema: patient(patient_id(INT), given_name(VARCHAR)), conditions(condition_id(INT), patient_id(INT), clinical_status(VARCHAR)) | question: Patients without active conditions
data.sql: SELECT given_name FROM patient WHERE patient_id NOT IN (SELECT patient_id FROM conditions WHERE clinical_status = 'ACTIVE')

data.input: schema: concept_datatype(concept_datatype_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), concept(concept_id(INT), datatype_id(INT)) | question: Types de données avec moins de 10 concepts
data.sql: SELECT name FROM concept_datatype WHERE concept_datatype_id IN (SELECT datatype_id FROM concept GROUP BY datatype_id HAVING COUNT(*) < 10)

data.input: schema: form_resource(form_resource_id(INT), form_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), form(form_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)) | question: Forms with resources
data.sql: SELECT name FROM form WHERE form_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT form_id FROM form_resource)

data.input: schema: user_role(user_id(INT), role(VARCHAR)), users(user_id(INT), username(VARCHAR)) | question: Utilisateurs avec le rôle 'Administrator'
data.sql: SELECT username FROM users WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM user_role WHERE role = 'Administrator')

data.input: schema: scheduler_task_config(task_config_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), scheduler_task_config_property(task_config_property_id(INT), task_config_id(INT)) | question: Scheduled tasks with properties
data.sql: SELECT name FROM scheduler_task_config WHERE task_config_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT task_config_id FROM scheduler_task_config_property)

data.input: schema: drug_reference_map(drug_reference_map_id(INT), drug_id(INT)), drug(drug_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), combination(BOOLEAN)) | question: Médicaments combinés avec mappings de référence
data.sql: SELECT name FROM drug WHERE combination = TRUE AND drug_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT drug_id FROM drug_reference_map)

data.input: schema: concept_map_type(concept_map_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), concept_reference_map(concept_map_id(INT), concept_map_type_id(INT)) | question: Map types never used
data.sql: SELECT name FROM concept_map_type WHERE concept_map_type_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT concept_map_type_id FROM concept_reference_map)

data.input: schema: hl7_source(hl7_source_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), hl7_in_queue(hl7_in_queue_id(INT), hl7_source(INT)) | question: Sources HL7 avec messages en attente
data.sql: SELECT name FROM hl7_source WHERE hl7_source_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT hl7_source FROM hl7_in_queue)

data.input: schema: obs(obs_id(INT), concept_id(INT), value_numeric(DECIMAL)), concept_numeric(concept_id(INT), hi_critical(DECIMAL)) | question: Concepts with critical high values exceeded
data.sql: SELECT DISTINCT concept_id FROM concept_numeric WHERE concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM obs WHERE value_numeric > (SELECT hi_critical FROM concept_numeric cn WHERE cn.concept_id = obs.concept_id))

data.input: schema: report_definition(report_definition_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), report_request(request_id(INT), report_definition_id(INT), status(VARCHAR)) | question: Rapports avec toutes les requêtes réussies
data.sql: SELECT name FROM report_definition WHERE report_definition_id NOT IN (SELECT report_definition_id FROM report_request WHERE status != 'COMPLETED')

data.input: schema: patient_program_attribute(attribute_id(INT), patient_program_id(INT)), patient_program(patient_program_id(INT), program_id(INT)) | question: Programs without any attributes
data.sql: SELECT DISTINCT program_id FROM patient_program WHERE patient_program_id NOT IN (SELECT patient_program_id FROM patient_program_attribute)

data.input: schema: encounter_role(encounter_role_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), encounter_provider(encounter_provider_id(INT), encounter_role_id(INT)) | question: Rôles utilisés dans plus de 100 consultations
data.sql: SELECT name FROM encounter_role WHERE encounter_role_id IN (SELECT encounter_role_id FROM encounter_provider GROUP BY encounter_role_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 100)

data.input: schema: patient(patient_id(INT), given_name(VARCHAR)), person(person_id(INT), birthdate(DATE)) | question: Youngest patient
data.sql: SELECT given_name FROM patient WHERE patient_id = (SELECT person_id FROM person WHERE birthdate = (SELECT MAX(birthdate) FROM person WHERE person_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM patient)))

data.input: schema: visit_attribute_type(visit_attribute_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), visit_attribute(attribute_id(INT), attribute_type_id(INT)) | question: Types d'attributs de visite jamais utilisés
data.sql: SELECT name FROM visit_attribute_type WHERE visit_attribute_type_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT attribute_type_id FROM visit_attribute)

data.input: schema: clob_datatype_storage(id(INT), uuid(VARCHAR)), obs(obs_id(INT), value_complex(VARCHAR)) | question: Complex obs without storage
data.sql: SELECT obs_id FROM obs WHERE value_complex IS NOT NULL AND value_complex NOT IN (SELECT uuid FROM clob_datatype_storage)

data.input: schema: privilege(privilege(VARCHAR), description(TEXT)), role_privilege(role(VARCHAR), privilege(VARCHAR)) | question: Privilèges non assignés à des rôles
data.sql: SELECT privilege FROM privilege WHERE privilege NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT privilege FROM role_privilege)

data.input: schema: encounter_type(encounter_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), encounter(encounter_id(INT), encounter_type(INT)), encounter_diagnosis(encounter_diagnosis_id(INT), encounter_id(INT)) | question: Encounter types with diagnoses
data.sql: SELECT name FROM encounter_type WHERE encounter_type_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT encounter_type FROM encounter WHERE encounter_id IN (SELECT encounter_id FROM encounter_diagnosis))

data.input: schema: person_merge_log(person_merge_log_id(INT), winner_person_id(INT)), patient(patient_id(INT)) | question: Personnes fusionnées qui sont maintenant patients
data.sql: SELECT person_merge_log_id FROM person_merge_log WHERE winner_person_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM patient)

data.input: schema: patient_state(patient_state_id(INT), state(INT)), program_workflow_state(program_workflow_state_id(INT), terminal(BOOLEAN)) | question: Patient states that are not terminal
data.sql: SELECT patient_state_id FROM patient_state WHERE state NOT IN (SELECT program_workflow_state_id FROM program_workflow_state WHERE terminal = TRUE)

data.input: schema: global_property(property(VARCHAR), property_value(TEXT)), concept(concept_id(INT), uuid(VARCHAR)) | question: Propriétés globales référençant des UUIDs de concepts
data.sql: SELECT property FROM global_property WHERE property_value IN (SELECT uuid FROM concept)

data.input: schema: encounter_attribute_type(encounter_attribute_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), encounter_attribute(attribute_id(INT), attribute_type_id(INT)) | question: Encounter attribute types used
data.sql: SELECT name FROM encounter_attribute_type WHERE encounter_attribute_type_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT attribute_type_id FROM encounter_attribute)

data.input: schema: order_group_attribute_type(order_group_attribute_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), order_group_attribute(order_group_attribute_id(INT), attribute_type_id(INT)) | question: Types d'attributs de groupe jamais utilisés
data.sql: SELECT name FROM order_group_attribute_type WHERE order_group_attribute_type_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT attribute_type_id FROM order_group_attribute)

data.input: schema: concept_proposal(concept_proposal_id(INT), state(VARCHAR), concept_id(INT)), concept(concept_id(INT), retired(BOOLEAN)) | question: Pending proposals for retired concepts
data.sql: SELECT concept_proposal_id FROM concept_proposal WHERE state = 'PENDING' AND concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE retired = TRUE)

data.input: schema: program(program_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), program_workflow(program_workflow_id(INT), program_id(INT)) | question: Programmes sans workflows
data.sql: SELECT name FROM program WHERE program_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT program_id FROM program_workflow)

data.input: schema: concept_answer(concept_answer_id(INT), concept_id(INT)), concept(concept_id(INT), is_set(BOOLEAN)) | question: Non-set concepts with answers
data.sql: SELECT DISTINCT concept_id FROM concept_answer WHERE concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE is_set = FALSE)

data.input: schema: reporting_report_design(id(INT), name(VARCHAR), report_definition_id(INT)), report_definition(report_definition_id(INT), published(BOOLEAN)) | question: Designs pour rapports publiés
data.sql: SELECT name FROM reporting_report_design WHERE report_definition_id IN (SELECT report_definition_id FROM report_definition WHERE published = TRUE)

data.input: schema: concept_state_conversion(concept_state_conversion_id(INT), concept_id(INT)), concept(concept_id(INT), retired(BOOLEAN)) | question: State conversions for active concepts
data.sql: SELECT concept_state_conversion_id FROM concept_state_conversion WHERE concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE retired = FALSE)

data.input: schema: encounter_diagnosis_attribute_type(encounter_diagnosis_attribute_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), encounter_diagnosis_attribute(encounter_diagnosis_attribute_id(INT), attribute_type_id(INT)) | question: Types d'attributs de diagnostic utilisés
data.sql: SELECT name FROM encounter_diagnosis_attribute_type WHERE encounter_diagnosis_attribute_type_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT attribute_type_id FROM encounter_diagnosis_attribute)

data.input: schema: order_attribute_type(order_attribute_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), order_attribute(order_attribute_id(INT), attribute_type_id(INT)) | question: Order attribute types never used
data.sql: SELECT name FROM order_attribute_type WHERE order_attribute_type_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT attribute_type_id FROM order_attribute)

data.input: schema: patient(patient_id(INT), given_name(VARCHAR)), allergy(allergy_id(INT), patient_id(INT), severity(VARCHAR)) | question: Patients avec plus d'allergies que la moyenne
data.sql: SELECT given_name FROM patient WHERE patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM allergy GROUP BY patient_id HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT AVG(allergy_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as allergy_count FROM allergy GROUP BY patient_id) as counts))

data.input: schema: users(user_id(INT), username(VARCHAR), creator(INT)) | question: Users created by system admin (user_id = 1)
data.sql: SELECT username FROM users WHERE creator = 1 AND user_id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE retired = TRUE)

data.input: schema: form(form_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), version(VARCHAR)), encounter(encounter_id(INT), form_id(INT)) | question: Dernière version de formulaire utilisée
data.sql: SELECT name, version FROM form WHERE form_id = (SELECT form_id FROM encounter ORDER BY encounter_datetime DESC LIMIT 1)

data.input: schema: cohort(cohort_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), cohort_member(cohort_member_id(INT), cohort_id(INT), end_date(DATE)) | question: Cohorts with all members still active
data.sql: SELECT name FROM cohort WHERE cohort_id NOT IN (SELECT cohort_id FROM cohort_member WHERE end_date IS NOT NULL AND end_date <= CURDATE())

data.input: schema: drug(drug_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), dose_strength(DECIMAL)), drug_order(order_id(INT), drug_inventory_id(INT)) | question: Médicaments à faible dose jamais prescrits
data.sql: SELECT name FROM drug WHERE dose_strength < 10 AND drug_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT drug_inventory_id FROM drug_order)

data.input: schema: location(location_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), patient_identifier(patient_identifier_id(INT), location_id(INT), voided(BOOLEAN)) | question: Locations with voided identifiers
data.sql: SELECT name FROM location WHERE location_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT location_id FROM patient_identifier WHERE voided = TRUE)

data.input: schema: concept(concept_id(INT), is_set(BOOLEAN)), concept_set(concept_set_id(INT), concept_set(INT)) | question: Concepts ensemble sans membres
data.sql: SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE is_set = TRUE AND concept_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT concept_set FROM concept_set)

data.input: schema: patient_program(patient_program_id(INT), patient_id(INT), date_enrolled(DATE)), patient(patient_id(INT), given_name(VARCHAR)) | question: Patients enrolled in programs this year
data.sql: SELECT given_name FROM patient WHERE patient_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM patient_program WHERE YEAR(date_enrolled) = YEAR(CURDATE()))

data.input: schema: person_address(person_address_id(INT), person_id(INT), preferred(BOOLEAN)), patient(patient_id(INT)) | question: Patients sans adresse préférée
data.sql: SELECT patient_id FROM patient WHERE patient_id NOT IN (SELECT person_id FROM person_address WHERE preferred = TRUE)

data.input: schema: provider(provider_id(INT), identifier(VARCHAR)), encounter_provider(encounter_provider_id(INT), provider_id(INT), voided(BOOLEAN)) | question: Providers with voided encounters
data.sql: SELECT identifier FROM provider WHERE provider_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT provider_id FROM encounter_provider WHERE voided = TRUE)

data.input: schema: person_name(person_name_id(INT), person_id(INT), preferred(BOOLEAN)), patient(patient_id(INT)) | question: Patients avec plusieurs noms préférés
data.sql: SELECT patient_id FROM patient WHERE patient_id IN (SELECT person_id FROM person_name WHERE preferred = TRUE GROUP BY person_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

data.input: schema: drug_order(order_id(INT), as_needed(BOOLEAN)), orders(order_id(INT), patient_id(INT)) | question: Patients with PRN medications only
data.sql: SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM orders WHERE patient_id NOT IN (SELECT o.patient_id FROM orders o INNER JOIN drug_order do ON o.order_id = do.order_id WHERE do.as_needed = FALSE)

data.input: schema: visit(visit_id(INT), patient_id(INT), indication_concept_id(INT)), concept(concept_id(INT), retired(BOOLEAN)) | question: Visites avec indication de concept retiré
data.sql: SELECT visit_id FROM visit WHERE indication_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE retired = TRUE)

data.input: schema: person(person_id(INT), cause_of_death(INT)), concept(concept_id(INT), class_id(INT)) | question: Deaths from diseases (class_id = 4)
data.sql: SELECT person_id FROM person WHERE cause_of_death IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE class_id = 4)

data.input: schema: allergy(allergy_id(INT), patient_id(INT), coded_allergen(INT)), concept(concept_id(INT), datatype_id(INT)) | question: Patients allergiques à des concepts numériques
data.sql: SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM allergy WHERE coded_allergen IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE datatype_id = 1)

data.input: schema: role(role(VARCHAR), description(TEXT)), user_role(user_id(INT), role(VARCHAR)) | question: Roles with more than 10 users
data.sql: SELECT role FROM role WHERE role IN (SELECT role FROM user_role GROUP BY role HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) > 10)

data.input: schema: drug(drug_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), retire_reason(INT)), concept(concept_id(INT), retired(BOOLEAN)) | question: Médicaments retirés pour concepts actifs
data.sql: SELECT name FROM drug WHERE retire_reason IS NOT NULL AND retire_reason IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE retired = FALSE)

data.input: schema: location_attribute_type(location_attribute_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), location_attribute(attribute_id(INT), attribute_type_id(INT)) | question: Location attribute types used more than once
data.sql: SELECT name FROM location_attribute_type WHERE location_attribute_type_id IN (SELECT attribute_type_id FROM location_attribute GROUP BY attribute_type_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

data.input: schema: orders(order_id(INT), patient_id(INT), discontinued(BOOLEAN)), patient(patient_id(INT), given_name(VARCHAR)) | question: Patients avec toutes leurs commandes discontinuées
data.sql: SELECT given_name FROM patient WHERE patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM orders GROUP BY patient_id HAVING COUNT(*) = SUM(CASE WHEN discontinued = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))

data.input: schema: program_attribute_type(program_attribute_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), program_id(INT)), patient_program_attribute(attribute_id(INT), attribute_type_id(INT)) | question: Program attribute types actually used
data.sql: SELECT name FROM program_attribute_type WHERE program_attribute_type_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT attribute_type_id FROM patient_program_attribute)

data.input: schema: drug_order(order_id(INT), route(INT)), concept(concept_id(INT), class_id(INT)) | question: Voies d'administration de classe 11
data.sql: SELECT DISTINCT route FROM drug_order WHERE route IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE class_id = 11)

data.input: schema: patient_program(patient_program_id(INT), patient_id(INT), outcome_concept_id(INT)), concept(concept_id(INT), is_set(BOOLEAN)) | question: Patients with set concept outcomes
data.sql: SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM patient_program WHERE outcome_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE is_set = TRUE)

data.input: schema: conditions(condition_id(INT), patient_id(INT), end_reason(INT)), concept(concept_id(INT), retired(BOOLEAN)) | question: Conditions terminées avec raison retirée
data.sql: SELECT condition_id FROM conditions WHERE end_reason IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE retired = TRUE)

data.input: schema: test_order(order_id(INT), frequency(INT)), order_frequency(order_frequency_id(INT), concept_id(INT)) | question: Test orders with undefined frequency
data.sql: SELECT order_id FROM test_order WHERE frequency IS NOT NULL AND frequency NOT IN (SELECT order_frequency_id FROM order_frequency)

data.input: schema: encounter(encounter_id(INT), patient_id(INT)), encounter_attribute(attribute_id(INT), encounter_id(INT)) | question: Patients avec consultations sans attributs
data.sql: SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM encounter WHERE encounter_id NOT IN (SELECT encounter_id FROM encounter_attribute)

data.input: schema: order_group(order_group_id(INT), patient_id(INT)), order_group_attribute(order_group_attribute_id(INT), order_group_id(INT)) | question: Patients with order groups without attributes
data.sql: SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM order_group WHERE order_group_id NOT IN (SELECT order_group_id FROM order_group_attribute)

data.input: schema: patient(patient_id(INT), given_name(VARCHAR)), encounter(encounter_id(INT), patient_id(INT)), obs(obs_id(INT), encounter_id(INT)) | question: Patients ayant des consultations avec observations
data.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.patient_id, p.given_name FROM patient p, encounter e, obs o WHERE p.patient_id = e.patient_id AND e.encounter_id = o.encounter_id

data.input: schema: person(person_id(INT), gender(VARCHAR)), patient(patient_id(INT)), visit(visit_id(INT), patient_id(INT)) | question: Female patients with visits
data.sql: SELECT DISTINCT pe.person_id FROM person pe, patient p, visit v WHERE pe.person_id = p.patient_id AND p.patient_id = v.patient_id AND pe.gender = 'F'

data.input: schema: drug(drug_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), drug_order(order_id(INT), drug_inventory_id(INT)), orders(order_id(INT), patient_id(INT)) | question: Médicaments prescrits avec identifiants patients
data.sql: SELECT d.name, o.patient_id FROM drug d, drug_order do, orders o WHERE d.drug_id = do.drug_inventory_id AND do.order_id = o.order_id

data.input: schema: location(location_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), encounter(encounter_id(INT), location_id(INT)), provider(provider_id(INT)), encounter_provider(encounter_provider_id(INT), encounter_id(INT), provider_id(INT)) | question: Locations with encounters and providers
data.sql: SELECT DISTINCT l.name, p.provider_id FROM location l, encounter e, encounter_provider ep, provider p WHERE l.location_id = e.location_id AND e.encounter_id = ep.encounter_id AND ep.provider_id = p.provider_id

data.input: schema: concept(concept_id(INT), is_set(BOOLEAN)), concept_name(concept_name_id(INT), concept_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), obs(obs_id(INT), concept_id(INT)) | question: Noms de concepts utilisés dans les observations
data.sql: SELECT DISTINCT cn.name FROM concept c, concept_name cn, obs o WHERE c.concept_id = cn.concept_id AND c.concept_id = o.concept_id AND c.is_set = FALSE

data.input: schema: patient_program(patient_program_id(INT), patient_id(INT), program_id(INT)), program(program_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), location(location_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)) | question: Programs and all locations (cartesian product for setup)
data.sql: SELECT p.name as program_name, l.name as location_name FROM program p, location l WHERE p.retired = FALSE AND l.retired = FALSE

data.input: schema: allergy(allergy_id(INT), patient_id(INT), severity(VARCHAR)), patient(patient_id(INT)), person(person_id(INT), birthdate(DATE)) | question: Allergies sévères chez patients de plus de 50 ans
data.sql: SELECT a.allergy_id FROM allergy a, patient p, person pe WHERE a.patient_id = p.patient_id AND p.patient_id = pe.person_id AND a.severity = 'SEVERE' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, pe.birthdate, CURDATE()) > 50

data.input: schema: users(user_id(INT), username(VARCHAR)), user_role(user_id(INT), role(VARCHAR)), role(role(VARCHAR), description(TEXT)) | question: Users with their role descriptions
data.sql: SELECT u.username, r.description FROM users u, user_role ur, role r WHERE u.user_id = ur.user_id AND ur.role = r.role

data.input: schema: form(form_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), encounter(encounter_id(INT), form_id(INT)), visit(visit_id(INT)), encounter(encounter_id(INT), visit_id(INT)) | question: Formulaires utilisés dans des visites
data.sql: SELECT DISTINCT f.name, v.visit_id FROM form f, encounter e1, visit v WHERE f.form_id = e1.form_id AND e1.visit_id = v.visit_id

data.input: schema: cohort(cohort_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), cohort_member(cohort_member_id(INT), cohort_id(INT), patient_id(INT)), patient_identifier(patient_identifier_id(INT), patient_id(INT), identifier(VARCHAR)) | question: Cohorts with patient identifiers
data.sql: SELECT c.name, pi.identifier FROM cohort c, cohort_member cm, patient_identifier pi WHERE c.cohort_id = cm.cohort_id AND cm.patient_id = pi.patient_id

data.input: schema: person_address(person_address_id(INT), person_id(INT), city_village(VARCHAR)), patient(patient_id(INT)), encounter(encounter_id(INT), patient_id(INT)) | question: Villes des patients ayant eu des consultations
data.sql: SELECT DISTINCT pa.city_village FROM person_address pa, patient p, encounter e WHERE pa.person_id = p.patient_id AND p.patient_id = e.patient_id AND pa.city_village IS NOT NULL

data.input: schema: provider(provider_id(INT), person_id(INT)), person_name(person_name_id(INT), person_id(INT), given_name(VARCHAR)), encounter_provider(encounter_provider_id(INT), provider_id(INT)) | question: Provider names who have encounters
data.sql: SELECT DISTINCT pn.given_name FROM provider p, person_name pn, encounter_provider ep WHERE p.person_id = pn.person_id AND p.provider_id = ep.provider_id

data.input: schema: relationship(relationship_id(INT), person_a(INT), person_b(INT)), person(person_id(INT), gender(VARCHAR)), patient(patient_id(INT)) | question: Relations entre patients de genres différents
data.sql: SELECT r.relationship_id FROM relationship r, person p1, person p2, patient pat1, patient pat2 WHERE r.person_a = p1.person_id AND r.person_b = p2.person_id AND p1.person_id = pat1.patient_id AND p2.person_id = pat2.patient_id AND p1.gender != p2.gender

data.input: schema: patient_identifier_type(patient_identifier_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), patient_identifier(patient_identifier_id(INT), identifier_type(INT)), visit(visit_id(INT), patient_id(INT)) | question: Identifier types for patients with visits
data.sql: SELECT DISTINCT pit.name FROM patient_identifier_type pit, patient_identifier pi, visit v WHERE pit.patient_identifier_type_id = pi.identifier_type AND pi.patient_id = v.patient_id

data.input: schema: diagnosis(diagnosis_id(INT), patient_id(INT)), conditions(condition_id(INT), patient_id(INT)), patient(patient_id(INT), given_name(VARCHAR)) | question: Patients ayant à la fois diagnostics et conditions
data.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.given_name FROM patient p, diagnosis d, conditions c WHERE p.patient_id = d.patient_id AND p.patient_id = c.patient_id

data.input: schema: orders(order_id(INT), patient_id(INT), care_setting(INT)), care_setting(care_setting_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), appointment(appointment_id(INT), patient_id(INT)) | question: Care settings for patients with appointments
data.sql: SELECT DISTINCT cs.name FROM orders o, care_setting cs, appointment a WHERE o.care_setting = cs.care_setting_id AND o.patient_id = a.patient_id

data.input: schema: test_order(order_id(INT)), orders(order_id(INT), encounter_id(INT)), encounter(encounter_id(INT), location_id(INT)) | question: Tests réalisés par location
data.sql: SELECT e.location_id, COUNT(t.order_id) as test_count FROM test_order t, orders o, encounter e WHERE t.order_id = o.order_id AND o.encounter_id = e.encounter_id GROUP BY e.location_id

data.input: schema: appointment_type(appointment_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), appointment(appointment_id(INT), appointment_type_id(INT), patient_id(INT)), patient_program(patient_program_id(INT), patient_id(INT)) | question: Appointment types for enrolled patients
data.sql: SELECT DISTINCT at.name FROM appointment_type at, appointment a, patient_program pp WHERE at.appointment_type_id = a.appointment_type_id AND a.patient_id = pp.patient_id

data.input: schema: note(note_id(INT), patient_id(INT)), obs(obs_id(INT), person_id(INT)), patient(patient_id(INT)) | question: Patients avec notes et observations
data.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.patient_id FROM patient p, note n, obs o WHERE p.patient_id = n.patient_id AND p.patient_id = o.person_id

data.input: schema: program_workflow(program_workflow_id(INT), program_id(INT)), patient_state(patient_state_id(INT), patient_program_id(INT)), patient_program(patient_program_id(INT), program_id(INT)) | question: Workflows with patient states
data.sql: SELECT pw.program_workflow_id, COUNT(ps.patient_state_id) as state_count FROM program_workflow pw, patient_state ps, patient_program pp WHERE pw.program_id = pp.program_id AND ps.patient_program_id = pp.patient_program_id GROUP BY pw.program_workflow_id

data.input: schema: drug_order(order_id(INT), frequency(INT)), order_frequency(order_frequency_id(INT), concept_id(INT)), concept_name(concept_name_id(INT), concept_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)) | question: Fréquences de prescription nommées
data.sql: SELECT DISTINCT cn.name FROM drug_order do, order_frequency of, concept_name cn WHERE do.frequency = of.order_frequency_id AND of.concept_id = cn.concept_id

data.input: schema: location_tag(location_tag_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), location_tag_map(location_id(INT), location_tag_id(INT)), encounter(encounter_id(INT), location_id(INT)) | question: Location tags for encounter locations
data.sql: SELECT DISTINCT lt.name FROM location_tag lt, location_tag_map ltm, encounter e WHERE lt.location_tag_id = ltm.location_tag_id AND ltm.location_id = e.location_id

data.input: schema: concept_datatype(concept_datatype_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), concept(concept_id(INT), datatype_id(INT)), concept_answer(concept_answer_id(INT), concept_id(INT)) | question: Types de données des concepts avec réponses

data.input: schema: form(form_id(INT), version(VARCHAR)), form_field(form_field_id(INT), form_id(INT)), encounter(encounter_id(INT), form_id(INT)) | question 692: Versions de formulaire avec plus de 20 champs et utilisées dans plus de 100 consultations

data.input: schema: concept(concept_id(INT), datatype_id(INT)), obs(obs_id(INT), concept_id(INT), value_numeric(DECIMAL)) | question 745: Concepts with average numeric value above 100

data.input: schema: orders(order_id(INT), order_type_id(INT), discontinued(BOOLEAN), discontinued_reason(INT)) | question 746: Order types with discontinuation rate above 25%
data.sql: SELECT order_type_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN discontinued = TRUE THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as discontinuation_rate FROM orders GROUP BY order_type_id HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN discontinued = TRUE THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > 25

data.input: schema: scheduler_task_config(task_config_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), start_on_startup(BOOLEAN)), scheduler_task_config_property(task_config_property_id(INT), task_config_id(INT)) | question 747: Startup tasks with more than 5 configuration properties
data.sql: SELECT stc.name, COUNT(stcp.task_config_property_id) as property_count FROM scheduler_task_config stc JOIN scheduler_task_config_property stcp ON stc.task_config_id = stcp.task_config_id WHERE stc.start_on_startup = TRUE GROUP BY stc.task_config_id, stc.name HAVING COUNT(stcp.task_config_property_id) > 5

data.input: schema: location(location_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), visit(visit_id(INT), location_id(INT), date_started(DATETIME)) | question 748: Locations avec plus de 100 visites ce mois
data.sql: SELECT l.name, COUNT(v.visit_id) as visit_count FROM location l JOIN visit v ON l.location_id = v.location_id WHERE MONTH(v.date_started) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(v.date_started) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY l.location_id, l.name HAVING COUNT(v.visit_id) > 100

data.input: schema: concept_class(concept_class_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), concept(concept_id(INT), class_id(INT)) | question 749: Classes de concepts avec plus de 50 concepts
data.sql: SELECT cc.name, COUNT(c.concept_id) as concept_count FROM concept_class cc JOIN concept c ON cc.concept_class_id = c.class_id GROUP BY cc.concept_class_id, cc.name HAVING COUNT(c.concept_id) > 50

data.input: schema: diagnosis(diagnosis_id(INT), diagnosis_coded(INT), certainty(VARCHAR)), encounter_diagnosis(encounter_diagnosis_id(INT), diagnosis_id(INT), encounter_id(INT)) | question 750: Coded diagnoses with presumed certainty in more than 40% of cases
data.sql: SELECT d.diagnosis_coded, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.certainty = 'PRESUMED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as presumed_rate FROM diagnosis d JOIN encounter_diagnosis ed ON d.diagnosis_id = ed.diagnosis_id WHERE d.diagnosis_coded IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.diagnosis_coded HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN d.certainty = 'PRESUMED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > 40

data.input: schema: order_group(order_group_id(INT), patient_id(INT)), orders(order_id(INT), order_group_id(INT)) | question 751: Patients avec groupes de commandes contenant plus de 10 ordres

data.input: schema: person_address(person_address_id(INT), city_village(VARCHAR), state_province(VARCHAR), person_id(INT)) | question 752: Villes avec plus de 100 personnes dans la même province
data.sql: SELECT city_village, state_province, COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) as person_count FROM person_address WHERE city_village IS NOT NULL AND state_province IS NOT NULL GROUP BY city_village, state_province HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) > 100

data.input: schema: allergy(allergy_id(INT), patient_id(INT), severity(VARCHAR), allergen(VARCHAR)) | question 753: Allergens causing severe reactions in more than 20 patients
data.sql: SELECT allergen, COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) as severe_reaction_count FROM allergy WHERE severity = 'SEVERE' GROUP BY allergen HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) > 20

data.input: schema: diagnosis(diagnosis_id(INT), diagnosis_coded(INT), certainty(VARCHAR)), encounter_diagnosis(encounter_diagnosis_id(INT), diagnosis_id(INT), encounter_id(INT)) | question 754: Coded diagnoses with presumed certainty in more than 40% of cases
data.sql: SELECT d.diagnosis_coded, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.certainty = 'PRESUMED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as presumed_rate FROM diagnosis d JOIN encounter_diagnosis ed ON d.diagnosis_id = ed.diagnosis_id WHERE d.diagnosis_coded IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.diagnosis_coded HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN d.certainty = 'PRESUMED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > 40

data.input: schema: order_set(order_set_id(INT), category(VARCHAR)), order_set_member(order_set_member_id(INT), order_set_id(INT)) | question 755: Order set categories with average members exceeding 10
data.sql: SELECT os.category, COUNT(osm.order_set_member_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT os.order_set_id) as avg_members FROM order_set os LEFT JOIN order_set_member osm ON os.order_set_id = osm.order_set_id WHERE os.category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY os.category HAVING COUNT(osm.order_set_member_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT os.order_set_id) > 10

data.input: schema: provider(provider_id(INT), person_id(INT)), encounter_provider(encounter_provider_id(INT), provider_id(INT), encounter_id(INT)) | question 756: Providers with more than 50 encounters
data.sql: SELECT p.provider_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ep.encounter_id) as encounter_count FROM provider p JOIN encounter_provider ep ON p.provider_id = ep.provider_id GROUP BY p.provider_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ep.encounter_id) > 50

data.input: schema: obs(obs_id(INT), person_id(INT), concept_id(INT), voided(BOOLEAN), voided_by(INT)) | question 757: Users who voided more than 50 observations

data.input: schema: conditions(condition_id(INT), clinical_status(VARCHAR), patient_id(INT)) | question 758: Statuts cliniques affectant plus de 100 patients
data.sql: SELECT clinical_status, COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) as patient_count FROM conditions GROUP BY clinical_status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) > 100

data.input: schema: appointment_type(appointment_type_id(INT), name(VARCHAR), duration(INT)), appointment(appointment_id(INT), appointment_type_id(INT), status(VARCHAR)) | question 759: Types de RDV avec plus de 80% de confirmations
data.sql: SELECT at.name, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status = 'CONFIRMED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as confirmation_rate FROM appointment_type at JOIN appointment a ON at.appointment_type_id = a.appointment_type_id GROUP BY at.appointment_type_id, at.name HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status = 'CONFIRMED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > 80

data.input: schema: report_definition(report_definition_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), report_request(request_id(INT), report_definition_id(INT), status(VARCHAR)) | question 760: Définitions de rapport avec taux d'échec supérieur à 20%
data.sql: SELECT rd.name, COUNT(CASE WHEN rr.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as failure_rate FROM report_definition rd JOIN report_request rr ON rd.report_definition_id = rr.report_definition_id GROUP BY rd.report_definition_id, rd.name HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN rr.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > 20

data.input: schema: patient_program(patient_program_id(INT), program_id(INT), patient_id(INT), date_enrolled(DATE)) | question 761: Programmes avec moins de 5 inscriptions cette année
data.sql: SELECT program_id, COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) as patient_count FROM patient_program WHERE YEAR(date_enrolled) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY program_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) < 5

data.input: schema: concept_proposal(concept_proposal_id(INT), state(VARCHAR), creator(INT), date_created(DATE)) | question 762: Creators with more than 5 pending proposals

data.input: schema: relationship_type(relationship_type_id(INT), a_is_to_b(VARCHAR)), relationship(relationship_id(INT), relationship(INT), person_a(INT)) | question 763: Types de relation avec plus de 50 relations actives
data.sql: SELECT rt.a_is_to_b, COUNT(r.relationship_id) as relationship_count FROM relationship_type rt JOIN relationship r ON rt.relationship_type_id = r.relationship GROUP BY rt.relationship_type_id, rt.a_is_to_b HAVING COUNT(r.relationship_id) > 50

data.input: schema: person(person_id(INT), birthdate(DATE)), allergy(allergy_id(INT), patient_id(INT)) | question 764: Age groups with more than 10 patients having allergies
data.sql: SELECT FLOOR(TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.birthdate, CURDATE())/10)*10 as age_group, COUNT(DISTINCT a.patient_id) as patient_count FROM person p JOIN allergy a ON p.person_id = a.patient_id WHERE p.birthdate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY age_group HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.patient_id) > 10

data.input: schema: drug_ingredient(drug_ingredient_id(INT), drug_id(INT), ingredient_id(INT), strength(DECIMAL)) | question 765: Drugs with more than 3 active ingredients
data.sql: SELECT drug_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ingredient_id) as ingredient_count FROM drug_ingredient GROUP BY drug_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ingredient_id) > 3

data.input: schema: cohort_member(cohort_member_id(INT), cohort_id(INT), patient_id(INT), start_date(DATE), end_date(DATE)) | question 766: Cohorts with member retention rate above 80%
data.sql: SELECT cohort_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN end_date IS NULL OR end_date > CURDATE() THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as retention_rate FROM cohort_member GROUP BY cohort_id HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN end_date IS NULL OR end_date > CURDATE() THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > 80

data.input: schema: field(field_id(INT), concept_id(INT), table_name(VARCHAR)), field_answer(field_id(INT), answer_id(INT)) | question 767: Tables avec champs ayant plus de 15 options de réponse en moyenne
data.sql: SELECT f.table_name, COUNT(fa.answer_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT f.field_id) as avg_answers_per_field FROM field f LEFT JOIN field_answer fa ON f.field_id = fa.field_id WHERE f.table_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY f.table_name HAVING COUNT(fa.answer_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT f.field_id) > 15

data.input: schema: program(program_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), patient_program(patient_program_id(INT), program_id(INT)), patient_state(patient_state_id(INT), patient_program_id(INT)) | question 768: Programmes avec moyenne de plus de 5 états par patient
data.sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(ps.patient_state_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT pp.patient_program_id) as avg_states_per_enrollment FROM program p JOIN patient_program pp ON p.program_id = pp.program_id LEFT JOIN patient_state ps ON pp.patient_program_id = ps.patient_program_id GROUP BY p.program_id, p.name HAVING COUNT(ps.patient_state_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT pp.patient_program_id) > 5

data.input: schema: concept_proposal(concept_proposal_id(INT), state(VARCHAR), creator(INT), date_created(DATE)) | question 769: Creators with more than 5 pending proposals

data.input: schema: encounter_provider(encounter_provider_id(INT), encounter_id(INT), provider_id(INT), encounter_role_id(INT)), encounter(encounter_id(INT), encounter_datetime(DATETIME)) | question 770: Prestataires avec plus de 20 consultations par jour en moyenne
data.sql: SELECT ep.provider_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.encounter_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(e.encounter_datetime)) as avg_daily_encounters FROM encounter_provider ep JOIN encounter e ON ep.encounter_id = e.encounter_id WHERE e.encounter_datetime IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ep.provider_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.encounter_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(e.encounter_datetime)) > 20

data.input: schema: visit(visit_id(INT), patient_id(INT), location_id(INT)), patient(patient_id(INT), birthdate(DATE)) | question 771: Locations with average patient age below 18
data.sql: SELECT v.location_id, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.birthdate, CURDATE())) as avg_age FROM visit v JOIN patient p ON v.patient_id = p.patient_id WHERE p.birthdate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY v.location_id HAVING AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.birthdate, CURDATE())) < 18

data.input: schema: global_property(property(VARCHAR), property_value(TEXT), description(TEXT)) | question 772: Property categories with more than 10 properties (grouped by prefix)

data.input: schema: provider_role(provider_role_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), provider(provider_id(INT), provider_role_id(INT)), encounter_provider(encounter_provider_id(INT), provider_id(INT)) | question 773: Provider roles with average encounters per provider exceeding 20
data.sql: SELECT pr.name, COUNT(ep.encounter_provider_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT p.provider_id) as avg_encounters_per_provider FROM provider_role pr JOIN provider p ON pr.provider_role_id = p.provider_role_id LEFT JOIN encounter_provider ep ON p.provider_id = ep.provider_id GROUP BY pr.provider_role_id, pr.name HAVING COUNT(ep.encounter_provider_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT p.provider_id) > 20

data.input: schema: visit(visit_id(INT), patient_id(INT), visit_type_id(INT)), obs(obs_id(INT), encounter_id(INT)), encounter(encounter_id(INT), visit_id(INT)) | question 775: Types de visite avec plus de 50 observations par visite en moyenne
data.sql: SELECT v.visit_type_id, COUNT(o.obs_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT v.visit_id) as avg_obs_per_visit FROM visit v LEFT JOIN encounter e ON v.visit_id = e.visit_id LEFT JOIN obs o ON e.encounter_id = o.encounter_id GROUP BY v.visit_type_id HAVING COUNT(o.obs_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT v.visit_id) > 50

data.input: schema: concept_datatype(concept_datatype_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), concept(concept_id(INT), datatype_id(INT)), concept_name(concept_name_id(INT), concept_id(INT)) | question 776: Datatypes with concepts having more than 3 names on average
data.sql: SELECT cd.name, COUNT(cn.concept_name_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.concept_id) as avg_names_per_concept FROM concept_datatype cd JOIN concept c ON cd.concept_datatype_id = c.datatype_id LEFT JOIN concept_name cn ON c.concept_id = cn.concept_id GROUP BY cd.concept_datatype_id, cd.name HAVING COUNT(cn.concept_name_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.concept_id) > 3

data.input: schema: drug_order(order_id(INT), drug_inventory_id(INT), dose(DECIMAL), quantity(INT)) | question 777: Drugs with total quantity ordered exceeding 1000 units

data.input: schema: visit(visit_id(INT), patient_id(INT), location_id(INT)), patient(patient_id(INT), birthdate(DATE)) | question 778: Locations with average patient age below 18

data.input: schema: allergy(allergy_id(INT), patient_id(INT), allergen_type(VARCHAR)), allergy_reaction(allergy_reaction_id(INT), allergy_id(INT), reaction_concept_id(INT)) | question 785: Allergen types causing more than 3 different reactions on average
data.sql: SELECT a.allergen_type, COUNT(DISTINCT ar.reaction_concept_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT a.allergy_id) as avg_reactions FROM allergy a LEFT JOIN allergy_reaction ar ON a.allergy_id = ar.allergy_id GROUP BY a.allergen_type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ar.reaction_concept_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT a.allergy_id) > 3

data.input: schema: notification_alert(alert_id(INT), creator(INT), satisfied_by_any(BOOLEAN)) | question 786: Créateurs avec plus de 10 alertes non satisfaites

data.input: schema: diagnosis(diagnosis_id(INT), diagnosis_coded(INT), certainty(VARCHAR)), encounter_diagnosis(encounter_diagnosis_id(INT), diagnosis_id(INT), encounter_id(INT)) | question 787: Coded diagnoses with presumed certainty in more than 40% of cases

data.input: schema: patient_state(patient_state_id(INT), state(INT), patient_program_id(INT), start_date(DATE), end_date(DATE)) | question 788: États avec durée moyenne supérieure à 180 jours

data.input: schema: patient_program(patient_program_id(INT), program_id(INT), location_id(INT), date_enrolled(DATE)) | question 789: Programmes par location avec plus de 50% d'inscriptions ce trimestre

data.input: schema: orders(order_id(INT), order_type_id(INT), discontinued(BOOLEAN), discontinued_reason(INT)) | question 790: Order types with discontinuation rate above 25%

data.input: schema: program_workflow_state(program_workflow_state_id(INT), program_workflow_id(INT), initial(BOOLEAN)), patient_state(patient_state_id(INT), state(INT), patient_program_id(INT)) | question 793: États initiaux utilisés par plus de 200 patients

data.input: schema: provider_role(provider_role_id(INT), name(VARCHAR)), provider(provider_id(INT), provider_role_id(INT)), encounter_provider(encounter_provider_id(INT), provider_id(INT)) | question 794: Provider roles with average encounters per provider exceeding 20

data.input: schema: test_order(order_id(INT), specimen_source(INT), urgency(VARCHAR)) | question 796: Sources d'échantillon avec plus de 80% de tests urgents

data.input: schema: obs(obs_id(INT), concept_id(INT), obs_datetime(DATETIME), location_id(INT)) | question 797: Locations avec plus de 1000 observations par mois en moyenne
data.sql: SELECT location_id, COUNT(*) / COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(obs_datetime, '%Y-%m')) as avg_monthly_obs FROM obs WHERE obs_datetime IS NOT NULL GROUP BY location_id HAVING COUNT(*) / COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(obs_datetime, '%Y-%m')) > 1000

data.input: schema: patient_identifier_type(patient_identifier_type_id(INT), required(BOOLEAN), check_digit(BOOLEAN)), patient_identifier(patient_identifier_id(INT), identifier_type(INT)) | question 798: Required identifier types with check digit having less than 95% valid identifiers
data.sql: SELECT pit.patient_identifier_type_id, COUNT(pi.patient_identifier_id) as total_identifiers FROM patient_identifier_type pit LEFT JOIN patient_identifier pi ON pit.patient_identifier_type_id = pi.identifier_type WHERE pit.required = TRUE AND pit.check_digit = TRUE GROUP BY pit.patient_identifier_type_id HAVING COUNT(pi.patient_identifier_id) < 95
